HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

Penglihatan yang baik merupakan bagian penting dalam menunjang aktivitas dan kualitas hidup sehari-hari. Untuk mendukung kenyamanan penggunaan dan membantu menjaga kesehatan mata, perhatikan panduan berikut:

CARA MERAWAT MGISPEC

Untuk membantu menjaga kebersihan, kenyamanan, dan kondisi kacamata MGISPEC agar tetap optimal, ikuti petunjuk perawatan berikut:

  1. Lipat tangkai kacamata sebelum meletakkan atau menyimpannya. Hindari meletakkan kacamata dengan permukaan depan lensa menghadap langsung ke meja atau permukaan lainnya untuk membantu mencegah goresan.
  2. Bersihkan lensa menggunakan air bersih atau cairan pembersih khusus lensa kacamata. Apabila terdapat minyak, debu, keringat, atau kotoran yang sulit dibersihkan, usap lensa secara perlahan menggunakan kain mikrofiber yang bersih dan lembut.
  3. Simpan kacamata di tempat yang sejuk dan kering, serta terlindung dari paparan sinar matahari langsung. Untuk penyimpanan normal, simpan pada suhu antara 0°C hingga 45°C.
  4. Hindari paparan suhu ekstrem dalam waktu lama. Jangan membiarkan produk berada pada suhu di bawah –10°C atau di atas 45°C dalam waktu yang berkepanjangan karena dapat menyebabkan perubahan bentuk atau deformasi pada bagian tertentu dari kacamata.
  5. Gunakan sabun yang lembut. Gunakan kain microfiber. (Jangan gunakan tisu atau bahan kain lain yang kasar.),
  6. Hindari penggunaan pembersih rumah tangga dan alkohol, Bersihkan kacamata secara rutin.

MGISPEC CLINICAL TRIAL RESULTS

MGISPEC functional eyewear technology was evaluated in a prospective, randomized, parallel-controlled clinical trial at Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. The study involved 150 participants divided into three groups, with eyewear worn for at least 8 hours per day for 15 consecutive days.

After 15 days, the MGISPEC group recorded a visual-fatigue score of 12.23 ± 1.34, compared with 17.87 ± 2.11 in the ordinary optical-eyewear group and 15.15 ± 1.77 in the conventional blue-light-filtering group (P=0.002). The overall effectiveness rate for visual-acuity improvement reached 90%, while the overall relief rate for dry-eye symptoms reached 92%. No serious adverse events were reported.

Important: the clinical trial evaluated the MGISPEC eyewear technology as an integrated system—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared, and blue-light filtering—not each individual material as a stand-alone medical treatment. The material descriptions above therefore reflect material characteristics and potential mechanisms discussed in the clinical report.

HOW TO USE MGISPEC

Good vision plays an important role in supporting daily activities and overall quality of life. To promote comfortable use and help maintain eye health, please follow these guidelines:

  1. Wear MGISPEC regularly for at least 8–10 hours per day, particularly during your daily activities.
  2. If you have a high degree of myopia (nearsightedness), hyperopia (farsightedness), or astigmatism, it is recommended that you consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional. MGISPEC lenses can be replaced with prescription lenses tailored to your individual vision needs by a qualified optical professional or based on the recommendation of an ophthalmologist.
  3. If you experience eye discomfort, eye-related symptoms, or changes in your vision, do not rely solely on wearing eyeglasses. You are advised to consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional for appropriate examination, evaluation, and treatment.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

MGISPEC products are not a substitute for professional medical examination, diagnosis, medication, or treatment. If you experience eye discomfort, vision problems, or have an existing eye condition, please consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional.

HOW TO CARE FOR YOUR MGISPEC

To help maintain the cleanliness, comfort, and overall condition of your MGISPEC eyewear, please follow these care instructions:

  1. Fold the temples before placing down or storing your eyewear. Avoid placing the glasses with the front surface of the lenses directly against a table or any other surface to help prevent scratches.
  2. Clean the lenses with clean water or a lens-cleaning solution specifically designed for eyeglasses. If oil, dust, perspiration, or other residue is difficult to remove, gently wipe the lenses with a clean, soft microfiber cloth.
  3. Store your eyewear in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Under normal storage conditions, keep the product at a temperature between 0°C and 45°C.
  4. Avoid prolonged exposure to extreme temperatures. Do not leave the product at temperatures below –10°C or above 45°C for extended periods, as extreme temperatures may cause deformation or changes in the shape of certain parts of the eyewear.
  5. Use mild soap when necessary and clean the lenses with a soft microfiber cloth. Do not use tissues, paper towels, or other rough materials, as they may scratch the lens surface.
  6. Avoid household cleaning products and alcohol. Clean your eyewear regularly to help prevent the accumulation of dust, oil, perspiration, and other residue.

MGISPEC 临床试验结果

MGISPEC 功能眼镜科技已在天津华厦眼科医院进行前瞻性、随机、平行对照临床试验。研究共纳入 150 名受试者，分为三组，每天佩戴至少 8 小时，连续 15 天。

15 天后，MGISPEC 组视觉疲劳评分为 12.23 ± 1.34；普通光学眼镜组为 17.87 ± 2.11；传统蓝光过滤眼镜组为 15.15 ± 1.77（P=0.002）。视力改善总体有效率达到 90%，干眼症状总体缓解率达到 92%，且未报告严重不良事件。

重要说明：临床试验评估的是 MGISPEC 负离子、远红外与蓝光过滤功能眼镜的整体技术系统，而不是证明每一种材料单独具有医疗治疗效果。上述材料功能说明主要体现材料特性及临床报告中讨论的潜在作用机制。

为了帮助保持 MGISPEC 眼镜的清洁、舒适度及良好状态，请遵循以下保养方法：

  1. 放置或收纳眼镜前，请先折叠镜腿。 请避免将镜片正面直接朝下放置在桌面或其他表面上，以帮助防止镜片刮伤。

HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

Gunakan sabun yang lembut. Gunakan kain microfiber. (Jangan gunakan tisu atau bahan kain lain yang kasar.),

1. BLACK TOURMALINE

Two Main Functions of Black Tourmaline:

  • Negative Ion Generation: Helps create a fresher and more comfortable environment.
  • Far-Infrared (FIR) Emission: Naturally emits far-infrared energy within the safe wavelength range of 4–14 micrometers (µm).

Potential Benefits in Everyday Applications:

  • Supports eye comfort.
  • Helps support microcirculation.
  • Provides a relaxing effect.

In MGISPEC, finely powdered Black Tourmaline is precisely integrated into the frame material to optimize its Negative Ion and FIR functions.

2. NEGATIVE IONS

Negative Ions are often referred to as "Vitamins in the Air" and play an important role in supporting eye comfort and reducing the risk of eye fatigue.

Functions of Negative Ions in MGISPEC:

  • Help reduce eye fatigue caused by prolonged use.
  • Designed to support eye comfort during daily activities, particularly when using digital devices.
  • Help provide a more relaxed and comfortable sensation around the eyes while wearing the glasses.
  • Support comfort around the eye and temple areas.

In the MGISPEC clinical report, Negative Ions are discussed as one of the potential mechanisms associated with free-radical neutralization, reduction of oxidative stress, and autonomic regulation, which may contribute to ocular muscle relaxation and eye comfort.

  1. FAR-INFRARED (FIR)

Far-Infrared (FIR) has a safe wavelength range of 4–14 µm (micrometers).

A micrometer is a unit used to measure extremely small lengths.

  • 1 micrometer (µm) = 0.001 millimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4,000 nanometers (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14,000 nanometers (nm).

Therefore, 4–14 µm refers to infrared wavelengths ranging from 4,000 to 14,000 nanometers.

FIR 4–14 µm (4,000–14,000 nm)

Benefits of Far-Infrared (FIR) in MGISPEC:

Furthermore, FIR within the 4–14 µm wavelength range is discussed in the MGISPEC clinical report as a potential mechanism that may support capillary dilation and blood supply to the ciliary muscles, retina, and choroid, thereby potentially supporting ocular microcirculation, comfort, and visual function.

MGISPEC CLINICAL TRIAL RESULTS

MGISPEC functional eyewear technology was evaluated in a prospective, randomized, parallel-controlled clinical trial at Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. The study involved 150 participants divided into three groups, with eyewear worn for at least 8 hours per day for 15 consecutive days.

After 15 days, the MGISPEC group recorded a visual-fatigue score of 12.23 ± 1.34, compared with 17.87 ± 2.11 in the ordinary optical-eyewear group and 15.15 ± 1.77 in the conventional blue-light-filtering group (P=0.002). The overall effectiveness rate for visual-acuity improvement reached 90%, while the overall relief rate for dry-eye symptoms reached 92%. No serious adverse events were reported.

Important: the clinical trial evaluated the MGISPEC eyewear technology as an integrated system—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared, and blue-light filtering—not each individual material as a stand-alone medical treatment. The material descriptions above therefore reflect material characteristics and potential mechanisms discussed in the clinical report.

黑碧玺的两大主要功能：

  • 产生负离子： 有助于营造更加清新、舒适的环境。
  • 释放远红外线（FIR）： 能够自然释放波长处于4–14微米（µm）安全范围内的远红外能量。

在日常应用中的潜在益处：

  • 有助于提升眼部舒适度。
  • 有助于促进微循环。
  • 提供放松舒缓的效果。

在MGISPEC眼镜中，经过精细研磨的黑碧玺粉末被精准地融入镜框材料中，以充分发挥其负离子及远红外线功能。

负离子在MGISPEC眼镜中的功能：

在MGISPEC临床报告中，负离子被列为潜在作用机制之一，其作用可能与中和自由基、减少氧化应激及调节自主神经系统有关，并可能有助于眼部肌肉放松及提升眼部舒适度。

  • 4 µm = 4,000纳米（nm）。
  • 14 µm = 14,000纳米（nm）。

因此，4–14 µm表示波长介于4,000至14,000纳米之间的红外线。

远红外线（FIR）：4–14 µm（4,000–14,000 nm）

远红外线（FIR）在MGISPEC眼镜中的益处：

MGISPEC 临床试验结果

MGISPEC 功能眼镜科技已在天津华厦眼科医院进行前瞻性、随机、平行对照临床试验。研究共纳入 150 名受试者，分为三组，每天佩戴至少 8 小时，连续 15 天。

15 天后，MGISPEC 组视觉疲劳评分为 12.23 ± 1.34；普通光学眼镜组为 17.87 ± 2.11；传统蓝光过滤眼镜组为 15.15 ± 1.77（P=0.002）。视力改善总体有效率达到 90%，干眼症状总体缓解率达到 92%，且未报告严重不良事件。

重要说明：临床试验评估的是 MGISPEC 负离子、远红外与蓝光过滤功能眼镜的整体技术系统，而不是证明每一种材料单独具有医疗治疗效果。上述材料功能说明主要体现材料特性及临床报告中讨论的潜在作用机制。

为了帮助保持 MGISPEC 眼镜的清洁、舒适度及良好状态，请遵循以下保养方法：

放置或收纳眼镜前，请先折叠镜腿。 请避免将镜片正面直接朝下放置在桌面或其他表面上，以帮助防止镜片刮伤。

请使用清水或眼镜镜片专用清洁液清洁镜片。 如果镜片上的油脂、灰尘、汗渍或其他污渍难以清除，请使用干净、柔软的超细纤维布轻轻擦拭。

避免长时间暴露于极端温度环境中。 请勿将产品长时间置于 –10°C 以下或 45°C 以上的环境中，因为极端温度可能导致眼镜的某些部件发生变形或形状变化。

必要时可使用温和的肥皂清洁，并使用柔软的超细纤维布擦拭镜片。 请勿使用纸巾、纸巾类清洁用品或其他粗糙材质擦拭镜片，以免刮伤镜片表面。

避免使用家用清洁剂或酒精清洁眼镜。 请定期清洁眼镜，以帮助减少灰尘、油脂、汗渍及其他污垢的积聚。

9 FITUR PERLINDUNGAN LENSA MGISPEC

1. UVA Protection – Perlindungan terhadap Sinar UVA

Lensa dirancang untuk membantu mengurangi paparan radiasi ultraviolet A (UVA) yang mencapai mata.

Paparan UVA berlebihan dalam jangka panjang dapat berkontribusi terhadap kerusakan pada struktur mata tertentu, termasuk lensa alami mata.

Perlindungan UVA membantu mengurangi risiko akibat paparan sinar ultraviolet dan mendukung kesehatan mata dalam jangka panjang, terutama bagi pengguna yang sering beraktivitas di luar ruangan.

2. UVB Protection – Perlindungan terhadap Sinar UVB

Lensa membantu menghalangi radiasi ultraviolet B (UVB), yang dapat menimbulkan gangguan pada permukaan mata apabila paparannya berlebihan.

Sinar UVB dapat menyebabkan fotokeratitis, yaitu peradangan akut pada kornea akibat radiasi ultraviolet.

Fitur perlindungan UVB membantu mengurangi paparan berbahaya tersebut dan mendukung perlindungan mata selama aktivitas sehari-hari.

3. Scratch Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Goresan

Permukaan lensa dirancang untuk memiliki ketahanan terhadap goresan ringan akibat penggunaan, pembersihan, dan kontak sehari-hari.

Fitur ini membantu mempertahankan kejernihan optik, mengurangi gangguan penglihatan akibat goresan pada permukaan lensa, serta mendukung daya tahan lensa dalam penggunaan jangka panjang.

4. Impact Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Benturan

Lensa menggunakan material Polycarbonate (PC) yang dikenal memiliki ketahanan benturan yang baik dibandingkan beberapa material lensa konvensional.

Karakteristik ini membantu mengurangi risiko kerusakan atau pecah akibat benturan tertentu dan memberikan perlindungan tambahan selama aktivitas sehari-hari.

Meskipun demikian, lensa tidak sepenuhnya kebal terhadap benturan keras.

5. Explosion Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Pecah dan Serpihan

Material PC memiliki karakteristik ketangguhan yang membantu mengurangi kemungkinan lensa pecah menjadi serpihan tajam ketika mengalami benturan atau tekanan tertentu.

Fitur ini mendukung keamanan pengguna dengan mengurangi risiko yang berkaitan dengan pecahnya material lensa.

Istilah ini merujuk pada ketahanan terhadap pecah, bukan jaminan perlindungan dari ledakan atau proyektil berkecepatan tinggi.

6. Oil Stain Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Noda Minyak

Permukaan lensa dirancang untuk membantu mengurangi penempelan minyak, sidik jari, dan noda berminyak.

Fitur ini mempermudah proses pembersihan, membantu mempertahankan kejernihan pandangan, dan membuat perawatan lensa menjadi lebih praktis.

Lensa yang bersih juga membantu mengurangi gangguan visual akibat noda pada permukaan.

7. Light and Magnetic Radiation Protection – Perlindungan terhadap Cahaya dan Radiasi Elektromagnetik

Teknologi lensa dirancang untuk mengatur transmisi cahaya pada rentang panjang gelombang tertentu sesuai karakteristik penyaringan optiknya.

Penyaringan cahaya yang sesuai dapat membantu mengurangi intensitas cahaya yang diteruskan ke mata serta mendukung kenyamanan visual dalam berbagai kondisi pencahayaan.

Perlindungan terhadap medan magnet atau jenis radiasi elektromagnetik lainnya memerlukan pengujian khusus dan tidak dapat disimpulkan hanya berdasarkan penggunaan material PC atau teknologi photochromic.

8. Static Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Listrik Statis

Fungsi antistatis menggunakan teknologi pelapisan khusus melalui proses Electrostatic Discharge Coating yang dirancang untuk membantu mengurangi akumulasi muatan listrik statis pada permukaan lensa.

Dengan berkurangnya muatan statis, kecenderungan debu dan partikel halus menempel akibat gaya elektrostatis dapat berkurang.

Fitur ini membantu menjaga kebersihan permukaan lensa, mempermudah perawatan, dan mendukung kenyamanan penggunaan sehari-hari.

9. Corrosion Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Korosi dan Pengaruh Lingkungan

Material lensa dirancang untuk memiliki ketahanan terhadap kondisi lingkungan serta paparan bahan tertentu sesuai karakteristik materialnya.

Fitur ini membantu menjaga stabilitas dan kualitas permukaan lensa serta mendukung daya tahan dalam penggunaan sehari-hari.

Ketahanan aktual tetap dipengaruhi oleh jenis bahan kimia, suhu, dan kondisi pemakaian.

PHOTOCHROMIC TEA – TEKNOLOGI PERUBAHAN WARNA BENING MENJADI COKELAT TEH

Teknologi Photochromic Tea memungkinkan lensa menyesuaikan tingkat kegelapan warnanya secara otomatis berdasarkan paparan sinar UV.

HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

CARA MENGGUNAKAN MGISPEC

Penglihatan yang baik merupakan bagian penting dalam menunjang aktivitas dan kualitas hidup sehari-hari. Untuk mendukung kenyamanan penggunaan dan membantu menjaga kesehatan mata, perhatikan panduan berikut:

Gunakan MGISPEC secara rutin selama minimal 8–10 jam per hari, terutama saat menjalani aktivitas sehari-hari.

Apabila Anda memiliki kelainan refraksi dengan ukuran minus, plus, atau silinder yang tinggi, disarankan untuk berkonsultasi dengan dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata. Lensa MGISPEC dapat diganti dengan lensa resep yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan penglihatan Anda melalui optik profesional atau berdasarkan rekomendasi dokter mata.

PERHATIAN

Produk MGISPEC bukan merupakan pengganti pemeriksaan, diagnosis, obat-obatan, maupun perawatan medis profesional. Apabila Anda memiliki keluhan, gangguan penglihatan, atau kondisi kesehatan mata tertentu, konsultasikan dengan dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata.

CARA MERAWAT MGISPEC

Untuk membantu menjaga kebersihan, kenyamanan, dan kondisi kacamata MGISPEC agar tetap optimal, ikuti petunjuk perawatan berikut:

Lipat tangkai kacamata sebelum meletakkan atau menyimpannya. Hindari meletakkan kacamata dengan permukaan depan lensa menghadap langsung ke meja atau permukaan lainnya untuk membantu mencegah goresan.

Bersihkan lensa menggunakan air bersih atau cairan pembersih khusus lensa kacamata. Apabila terdapat minyak, debu, keringat, atau kotoran yang sulit dibersihkan, usap lensa secara perlahan menggunakan kain mikrofiber yang bersih dan lembut.

Simpan kacamata di tempat yang sejuk dan kering, serta terlindung dari paparan sinar matahari langsung. Untuk penyimpanan normal, simpan pada suhu antara 0°C hingga 45°C.

Hindari paparan suhu ekstrem dalam waktu lama. Jangan membiarkan produk berada pada suhu di bawah –10°C atau di atas 45°C dalam waktu yang berkepanjangan karena dapat menyebabkan perubahan bentuk atau deformasi pada bagian tertentu dari kacamata.

Gunakan sabun yang lembut. Gunakan kain microfiber. (Jangan gunakan tisu atau bahan kain lain yang kasar.),

Hindari penggunaan pembersih rumah tangga dan alkohol, Bersihkan kacamata secara rutin.

THE ADVANTAGE OF PHOTOCHROMIC LENSES

Photochromic technology allows the lenses to respond automatically to changing UV/light conditions, providing a convenient transition between indoor and outdoor environments.

Under cloudy conditions or moderate UV exposure: the lenses begin to darken according to environmental conditions.

12 ADVANCED FUNCTIONAL MATERIALS

FRAME & TEMPLES

1. BLACK TOURMALINE

Black Tourmaline is a natural mineral known for its unique properties in naturally generating Negative Ions and emitting Far-Infrared (FIR) radiation.

Two Main Functions of Black Tourmaline:

  • Negative Ion Generation: Helps create a fresher and more comfortable environment.
  • Far-Infrared (FIR) Emission: Naturally emits far-infrared energy within the safe wavelength range of 4–14 micrometers (µm).

Potential Benefits in Everyday Applications:

  • Supports eye comfort.
  • Helps support microcirculation.
  • Provides a relaxing effect.
  • Supports comfort during prolonged wear.

In MGISPEC, finely powdered Black Tourmaline is precisely integrated into the frame material to optimize its Negative Ion and FIR functions.

2. NEGATIVE IONS

Negative Ions are often referred to as "Vitamins in the Air" and play an important role in supporting eye comfort and reducing the risk of eye fatigue.

Functions of Negative Ions in MGISPEC:

  • Help reduce eye fatigue caused by prolonged use.
  • Designed to support eye comfort during daily activities, particularly when using digital devices.
  • Help provide a more relaxed and comfortable sensation around the eyes while wearing the glasses.
  • Support comfort around the eye and temple areas.

In the MGISPEC clinical report, Negative Ions are discussed as one of the potential mechanisms associated with free-radical neutralization, reduction of oxidative stress, and autonomic regulation, which may contribute to ocular muscle relaxation and eye comfort.

  1. FAR-INFRARED (FIR)

Far-Infrared (FIR) has a safe wavelength range of 4–14 µm (micrometers).

A micrometer is a unit used to measure extremely small lengths.

  • 1 micrometer (µm) = 0.001 millimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4,000 nanometers (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14,000 nanometers (nm).

Therefore, 4–14 µm refers to infrared wavelengths ranging from 4,000 to 14,000 nanometers.

FIR 4–14 µm (4,000–14,000 nm)

Benefits of Far-Infrared (FIR) in MGISPEC:

  • Helps improve blood circulation in areas subjected to pressure.
  • Helps relieve muscle fatigue around the eyes.
  • Helps facilitate moisture absorption and release to reduce feelings of heat and stickiness.
  • Provides supplementary antibacterial and deodorizing effects.
  • Helps neutralize static electricity.

Furthermore, FIR within the 4–14 µm wavelength range is discussed in the MGISPEC clinical report as a potential mechanism that may support capillary dilation and blood supply to the ciliary muscles, retina, and choroid, thereby potentially supporting ocular microcirculation, comfort, and visual function.

9 ADVANCED LENS PROTECTION FEATURES

1. UVA Protection

Designed to help reduce the amount of ultraviolet A (UVA) radiation reaching the eyes.

Excessive long-term UVA exposure may contribute to damage to certain ocular structures, including the natural crystalline lens.

UVA protection helps reduce UV-related risks and supports long-term eye health, particularly during outdoor activities.

2. UVB Protection

Helps block ultraviolet B (UVB) radiation, which can damage the surface tissues of the eyes following excessive exposure.

UVB radiation may cause photokeratitis, an acute inflammatory condition affecting the cornea.

This protective feature helps reduce harmful UV exposure and supports eye protection during daily activities.

3. Scratch Resistant

Engineered to provide resistance against minor scratches caused by routine handling, cleaning, and everyday use.

This feature helps preserve optical clarity, reduce visual disturbances associated with surface scratches, and maintain lens durability over time.

4. Impact Resistant

Manufactured using Polycarbonate (PC), a material recognized for its good impact resistance compared with several conventional optical lens materials.

This characteristic helps reduce the likelihood of lens damage or breakage from certain impacts and provides additional protection during daily activities.

However, the lenses are not completely impact-proof.

5. Explosion Resistant / Shatter Resistant

The toughness of polycarbonate helps reduce the likelihood of the lenses breaking into sharp fragments under certain impact or pressure conditions.

This property contributes to user safety by reducing risks associated with lens fragmentation.

It does not mean the lenses are explosion-proof or certified to protect against high-velocity projectiles.

6. Oil Stain Resistant

The lens surface is designed to help resist oily fingerprints, grease, and everyday oil-based stains.

This feature makes cleaning more convenient, helps maintain optical clarity, and supports easier lens maintenance.

Keeping lenses clean also helps minimize visual disturbances caused by surface contamination.

7. Light and Magnetic Radiation Protection

The lens technology is designed to manage light transmission across selected wavelengths according to its optical filtering characteristics.

Appropriate light filtering can help reduce transmitted light intensity and support visual comfort under different lighting conditions.

Protection against magnetic fields or other types of electromagnetic radiation requires specific testing and cannot be assumed solely from polycarbonate or photochromic technology.

8. Static Resistant

Incorporates a specialized Electrostatic Discharge Coating Process designed to help reduce the accumulation of static electrical charges on the lens surface.

By minimizing static buildup, this technology may help reduce the electrostatic attraction of airborne dust and fine particles.

This feature supports a cleaner lens surface, easier maintenance, and improved everyday convenience.

9. Corrosion Resistant

Designed with material characteristics that provide resistance to certain environmental conditions and chemical exposures.

This feature helps preserve lens surface quality, maintain material stability, and support durability during everyday use.

Actual resistance depends on the chemical substance, temperature, and exposure conditions.

PHOTOCHROMIC TEA – CLEAR-TO-TEA-BROWN COLOR TRANSITION

Photochromic Tea Technology allows the lenses to automatically adjust their tint intensity in response to UV exposure.

Indoors

The lenses remain relatively clear, providing a natural appearance and supporting clear vision for everyday activities.

Outdoors

When exposed to sufficient UV light, the lenses gradually develop a tea-brown tint. This helps reduce transmitted light intensity while creating a warmer visual appearance.

Returning Indoors

As UV exposure decreases, the tea-brown tint gradually fades and the lenses return toward their clear state.

MGISPEC CLINICAL TRIAL RESULTS

MGISPEC functional eyewear technology was evaluated in a prospective, randomized, parallel-controlled clinical trial at Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. The study involved 150 participants divided into three groups, with eyewear worn for at least 8 hours per day for 15 consecutive days.

After 15 days, the MGISPEC group recorded a visual-fatigue score of 12.23 ± 1.34, compared with 17.87 ± 2.11 in the ordinary optical-eyewear group and 15.15 ± 1.77 in the conventional blue-light-filtering group (P=0.002). The overall effectiveness rate for visual-acuity improvement reached 90%, while the overall relief rate for dry-eye symptoms reached 92%. No serious adverse events were reported.

Important: the clinical trial evaluated the MGISPEC eyewear technology as an integrated system—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared, and blue-light filtering—not each individual material as a stand-alone medical treatment. The material descriptions above therefore reflect material characteristics and potential mechanisms discussed in the clinical report.

HOW TO USE MGISPEC

Good vision plays an important role in supporting daily activities and overall quality of life. To promote comfortable use and help maintain eye health, please follow these guidelines:

Wear MGISPEC regularly for at least 8–10 hours per day, particularly during your daily activities.

If you have a high degree of myopia (nearsightedness), hyperopia (farsightedness), or astigmatism, it is recommended that you consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional. MGISPEC lenses can be replaced with prescription lenses tailored to your individual vision needs by a qualified optical professional or based on the recommendation of an ophthalmologist.

If you experience eye discomfort, eye-related symptoms, or changes in your vision, do not rely solely on wearing eyeglasses. You are advised to consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional for appropriate examination, evaluation, and treatment.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

MGISPEC products are not a substitute for professional medical examination, diagnosis, medication, or treatment. If you experience eye discomfort, vision problems, or have an existing eye condition, please consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional.

HOW TO TAKE CARE FOR YOUR MGISPEC

To help maintain the cleanliness, comfort, and overall condition of your MGISPEC eyewear, please follow these care instructions:

Fold the temples before placing down or storing your eyewear. Avoid placing the glasses with the front surface of the lenses directly against a table or any other surface to help prevent scratches.

Clean the lenses with clean water or a lens-cleaning solution specifically designed for eyeglasses. If oil, dust, perspiration, or other residue is difficult to remove, gently wipe the lenses with a clean, soft microfiber cloth.

Store your eyewear in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Under normal storage conditions, keep the product at a temperature between 0°C and 45°C.

Avoid prolonged exposure to extreme temperatures. Do not leave the product at temperatures below –10°C or above 45°C for extended periods, as extreme temperatures may cause deformation or changes in the shape of certain parts of the eyewear.

Use mild soap when necessary and clean the lenses with a soft microfiber cloth. Do not use tissues, paper towels, or other rough materials, as they may scratch the lens surface.

Avoid household cleaning products and alcohol. Clean your eyewear regularly to help prevent the accumulation of dust, oil, perspiration, and other residue.

黑碧玺是一种天然矿物，以其能够自然产生负离子及释放远红外线（FIR）的独特特性而闻名。

黑碧玺的两大主要功能：

  1. 远红外线（FAR-INFRARED / FIR）

远红外线（FIR）的安全波长范围为4–14 µm（微米）。

微米是一种用于测量极微小长度的单位。

  • 1微米（µm）= 0.001毫米（mm）。
  • 4 µm = 4,000纳米（nm）。
  • 14 µm = 14,000纳米（nm）。

因此，4–14 µm表示波长介于4,000至14,000纳米之间的红外线。

远红外线（FIR）：4–14 µm（4,000–14,000 nm）

远红外线（FIR）在MGISPEC眼镜中的益处：

  • 有助于改善受压部位的血液循环。
  • 有助于缓解眼周肌肉疲劳。
  • 有助于促进湿气的吸收与排出，减少闷热及黏腻感。
  • 提供辅助性的抗菌及除臭效果。
  • 有助于中和静电。

此外，MGISPEC临床报告指出，波长范围为4–14 µm的远红外线可能是一种潜在的作用机制，有助于促进毛细血管扩张，并改善睫状肌、视网膜及脉络膜的血液供应，从而可能支持眼部微循环、提升眼部舒适度及维持视觉功能。

MGISPEC 九大镜片防护功能

1. UVA Protection — UVA 长波紫外线防护

镜片设计旨在帮助减少进入眼睛的长波紫外线（UVA）。

长期过量接触 UVA 可能对眼部部分组织造成损伤，包括眼睛的天然晶状体。

UVA 防护有助于降低紫外线暴露带来的潜在风险，为日常户外活动提供额外的眼部保护。

2. UVB Protection — UVB 中波紫外线防护

帮助阻挡中波紫外线（UVB），减少过量紫外线对眼睛表面组织造成的影响。

UVB 过度照射可能引起光性角膜炎，即紫外线造成的急性角膜炎症。

该防护功能有助于减少有害紫外线暴露，为日常眼部健康提供支持。

3. Scratch Resistant — 耐刮擦性能

镜片表面经过专门设计，能够抵抗日常使用、清洁及接触过程中产生的轻微刮擦。

有助于保持镜片的光学清晰度，减少表面划痕对视觉体验的影响，并提升镜片的长期耐用性。

4. Impact Resistant — 抗冲击性能

采用聚碳酸酯（PC）材料，相较于部分传统光学镜片材料，具有良好的抗冲击特性。

这种性能有助于降低特定碰撞造成镜片损坏或破裂的风险，为日常佩戴提供额外的安全保障。

但镜片并非完全不会因强烈冲击而损坏。

5. Explosion Resistant / Shatter Resistant — 抗碎裂性能

聚碳酸酯材料具有一定的韧性，在特定冲击或压力条件下，有助于降低镜片破裂并形成尖锐碎片的可能性。

这种材料特性有助于减少镜片碎裂带来的潜在风险，提升日常使用的安全性。

但这并不代表镜片具有防爆认证或能够防护高速飞射物。

6. Oil Stain Resistant — 抗油污性能

镜片表面设计有助于减少油脂、指纹及日常油性污渍的附着。

使镜片更容易清洁，并有助于维持清晰视野，提升日常佩戴与保养的便利性。

保持镜片清洁也有助于减少污渍对视觉体验的影响。

7. Light and Magnetic Radiation Protection — 光线及电磁辐射防护

镜片可根据其光学过滤特性，对特定波长范围内的光线进行选择性过滤。

适当的光线过滤有助于减少透过镜片的光线强度，并提升不同光照环境下的视觉舒适度。

需要注意的是，对于磁场或其他类型电磁辐射的防护效果，必须通过专项测试验证，不能仅凭 PC 材料或光致变色技术作出判断。

8. Static Resistant — 抗静电性能

采用专门的静电释放涂层工艺（Electrostatic Discharge Coating Process），旨在减少镜片表面静电荷的积聚。

MGISPEC 临床试验结果

MGISPEC 功能眼镜科技已在天津华厦眼科医院进行前瞻性、随机、平行对照临床试验。研究共纳入 150 名受试者，分为三组，每天佩戴至少 8 小时，连续 15 天。

15 天后，MGISPEC 组视觉疲劳评分为 12.23 ± 1.34；普通光学眼镜组为 17.87 ± 2.11；传统蓝光过滤眼镜组为 15.15 ± 1.77（P=0.002）。视力改善总体有效率达到 90%，干眼症状总体缓解率达到 92%，且未报告严重不良事件。

重要说明：临床试验评估的是 MGISPEC 负离子、远红外与蓝光过滤功能眼镜的整体技术系统，而不是证明每一种材料单独具有医疗治疗效果。上述材料功能说明主要体现材料特性及临床报告中讨论的潜在作用机制。

9 FITUR PERLINDUNGAN LENSA MGISPEC

1. UVA Protection – Perlindungan terhadap Sinar UVA

Dirancang untuk membantu mengurangi paparan radiasi ultraviolet A (UVA) yang mencapai mata. Sinar UVA dapat menembus lebih dalam ke jaringan mata dan paparan berlebihan dalam jangka panjang berhubungan dengan risiko kerusakan pada struktur mata tertentu.

Perlindungan UVA membantu menjaga kesehatan mata dalam aktivitas sehari-hari, khususnya ketika berada di luar ruangan.

2. UVB Protection – Perlindungan terhadap Sinar UVB

Membantu menghalangi radiasi ultraviolet B (UVB), yang dapat menyebabkan kerusakan pada permukaan mata akibat paparan berlebihan.

Perlindungan ini penting untuk membantu mengurangi risiko gangguan mata akibat sinar UV, termasuk fotokeratitis, serta mendukung perlindungan mata jangka panjang.

3. Scratch Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Goresan

Permukaan lensa dirancang untuk memiliki ketahanan terhadap goresan ringan akibat penggunaan dan perawatan sehari-hari.

Fitur ini membantu mempertahankan kejernihan lensa, mengurangi gangguan visual akibat goresan, dan mendukung kenyamanan penglihatan dalam penggunaan jangka panjang.

4. Impact Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Benturan

Material Polycarbonate (PC) dikenal memiliki ketahanan benturan yang baik dibandingkan sejumlah material lensa konvensional.

Fitur ini membantu mengurangi risiko lensa pecah akibat benturan ringan hingga sedang dan memberikan perlindungan tambahan selama aktivitas sehari-hari. Ketahanan benturan tidak berarti lensa sepenuhnya bebas dari kerusakan.

5. Explosion Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Pecah atau Serpihan

Dirancang dengan karakteristik material yang membantu mengurangi kemungkinan lensa pecah menjadi serpihan tajam ketika mengalami tekanan atau benturan tertentu.

Fitur ini memberikan aspek keamanan tambahan bagi pengguna. Namun, lensa bukan merupakan pelindung terhadap ledakan atau proyektil berkecepatan tinggi kecuali telah memenuhi standar keselamatan khusus.

6. Oil Stain Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Noda Minyak

Permukaan lensa dirancang untuk membantu mengurangi penempelan minyak, sidik jari, dan noda berminyak.

Fitur ini mempermudah pembersihan dan membantu menjaga kejernihan pandangan, sehingga lensa lebih praktis digunakan sepanjang hari.

7. Light and Magnetic Radiation Protection – Perlindungan terhadap Cahaya dan Radiasi Elektromagnetik

Teknologi lensa dirancang untuk mengelola paparan cahaya pada rentang panjang gelombang tertentu sesuai karakteristik penyaringan optiknya.

Fitur penyaringan cahaya dapat membantu mengurangi paparan panjang gelombang tertentu dan meningkatkan kenyamanan visual. Namun, perlindungan terhadap medan magnet atau seluruh jenis radiasi elektromagnetik memerlukan pengujian khusus dan tidak dapat disimpulkan hanya dari penggunaan material PC.

8. Static Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Listrik Statis

Menggunakan proses pelapisan khusus (electrostatic discharge coating process) yang dirancang untuk membantu mengurangi akumulasi muatan listrik statis pada permukaan lensa.

Teknologi ini berpotensi mengurangi kecenderungan debu dan partikel halus menempel akibat gaya elektrostatis, sehingga membantu menjaga kebersihan permukaan lensa dan kenyamanan penggunaan.

9. Corrosion Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Korosi dan Pengaruh Lingkungan

Material lensa dirancang untuk memiliki ketahanan terhadap kondisi lingkungan dan paparan bahan tertentu sesuai karakteristik materialnya.

Fitur ini membantu mempertahankan kualitas permukaan serta mendukung daya tahan lensa dalam penggunaan sehari-hari. Ketahanannya tetap bergantung pada jenis bahan kimia, suhu, dan kondisi penggunaan.

Di dalam ruangan: Lensa cenderung bening untuk mendukung penglihatan yang jelas dan natural.

Di luar ruangan: Lensa secara bertahap berubah menjadi biru ketika menerima paparan UV yang memadai, membantu mengurangi intensitas cahaya yang diteruskan.

Kembali ke dalam ruangan: Lensa berangsur kembali menjadi bening seiring berkurangnya paparan UV.

Kecepatan dan tingkat perubahan warna dipengaruhi oleh intensitas UV, suhu, dan kondisi lingkungan. Perubahan warna tidak selalu terjadi secara maksimal di balik kaca mobil yang menghalangi sinar UV.

HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

LEBIH ADAPTIF UNTUK GAYA HIDUP MODERN

Dari bekerja di depan layar, membaca, berkendara, hingga beraktivitas di luar ruangan, MGISPEC PC47 Photochromic Series dirancang sebagai eyewear modern yang menggabungkan kenyamanan, adaptasi terhadap perubahan cahaya, teknologi material fungsional, dan perlindungan lensa dalam satu desain premium.

12 ADVANCED FUNCTIONAL MATERIALS IN THE FRAME & TEMPLES

1. BLACK TOURMALINE

Black Tourmaline is a natural mineral known for its unique properties in naturally generating Negative Ions and emitting Far-Infrared (FIR) radiation.

Two Main Functions of Black Tourmaline:

  • Negative Ion Generation: Helps create a fresher and more comfortable environment.
  • Far-Infrared (FIR) Emission: Naturally emits far-infrared energy within the safe wavelength range of 4–14 micrometers (µm).

Potential Benefits in Everyday Applications:

  • Supports eye comfort.
  • Helps support microcirculation.
  • Provides a relaxing effect.
  • Supports comfort during prolonged wear.

In MGISPEC, finely powdered Black Tourmaline is precisely integrated into the frame material to optimize its Negative Ion and FIR functions.

2. NEGATIVE IONS

Negative Ions are often referred to as "Vitamins in the Air" and play an important role in supporting eye comfort and reducing the risk of eye fatigue.

Functions of Negative Ions in MGISPEC:

  • Help reduce eye fatigue caused by prolonged use.
  • Designed to support eye comfort during daily activities, particularly when using digital devices.
  • Help provide a more relaxed and comfortable sensation around the eyes while wearing the glasses.
  • Support comfort around the eye and temple areas.

In the MGISPEC clinical report, Negative Ions are discussed as one of the potential mechanisms associated with free-radical neutralization, reduction of oxidative stress, and autonomic regulation, which may contribute to ocular muscle relaxation and eye comfort.

  1. FAR-INFRARED (FIR)

Far-Infrared (FIR) has a safe wavelength range of 4–14 µm (micrometers).

A micrometer is a unit used to measure extremely small lengths.

  • 1 micrometer (µm) = 0.001 millimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4,000 nanometers (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14,000 nanometers (nm).

Therefore, 4–14 µm refers to infrared wavelengths ranging from 4,000 to 14,000 nanometers.

FIR 4–14 µm (4,000–14,000 nm)

Benefits of Far-Infrared (FIR) in MGISPEC:

  • Helps improve blood circulation in areas subjected to pressure.
  • Helps relieve muscle fatigue around the eyes.
  • Helps facilitate moisture absorption and release to reduce feelings of heat and stickiness.
  • Provides supplementary antibacterial and deodorizing effects.
  • Helps neutralize static electricity.

Furthermore, FIR within the 4–14 µm wavelength range is discussed in the MGISPEC clinical report as a potential mechanism that may support capillary dilation and blood supply to the ciliary muscles, retina, and choroid, thereby potentially supporting ocular microcirculation, comfort, and visual function.

4. NANO SILVER

A material technology with strong, broad-spectrum antibacterial, antiviral, and antifungal capabilities.

Silver is recognized in materials science for its antimicrobial characteristics in certain applications and formulations. In MGISPEC, Nano Silver is incorporated as part of the nanomaterial technology used in the frame and temple system.

  1. GERMANIUM (Ge)

A functional material technology with semiconductor characteristics, integrated with other minerals as part of MGISPEC's comprehensive material system.

  • Helps regulate the body's micro-bioelectrical currents to relieve nervous tension.
  • Helps enhance Far-Infrared (FIR) resonance to support local microcirculation.
  • Helps generate mild Negative Ions to neutralize electromagnetic static electricity.
  • Helps support antibacterial comfort and reduce the risk of skin allergies.
  • Helps maintain temperature stability and reduce moisture caused by perspiration.
  • Helps provide beneficial antioxidant functions.

6. GRAPHENE

An advanced carbon-based functional material technology that is strong and lightweight, with excellent physical and thermal properties.

  • Helps dissipate heat very rapidly to reduce feelings of heat and stickiness (Key Advantage).
  • Supports Far-Infrared (FIR) functions to reduce pressure marks and discomfort around the eyes.
  • Provides mild antistatic and Negative Ion effects to reduce dust accumulation.
  • Helps comprehensively enhance the durability of eyeglass frames (Additional Advantage).

7. BAMBOO CHARCOAL

A carbon-based material technology with a porous structure, used as part of MGISPEC's functional material formulation.

  • Helps absorb odors, oil, and perspiration (Main Advantage).
  • Helps regulate moisture for a dry, non-sticky, and comfortable wearing experience.
  • Provides mild Far-Infrared (FIR) emission to support local blood circulation.
  • Provides a physical antibacterial effect as a supplementary function.

8. FUNCTIONAL MINERAL BLEND

A combination of selected minerals designed to work as part of an integrated material system. It supports the functions of each component contained in MGISPEC.

  1. ZINC OXIDE (ZnO)

A material widely used in material technology due to its stability and functional characteristics, and incorporated as part of MGISPEC's nanomaterial formulation.

  • Helps provide a long-lasting, broad-spectrum antibacterial effect.
  • Helps provide broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection to slow down frame aging and discoloration.
  • Supports mild thermal conductivity and heat dissipation to reduce feelings of heat and stickiness.
  • Helps reinforce the frame material to improve resistance to wear and deformation.
  1. TITANIUM DIOXIDE (TiO₂)

A stable material commonly used in various material technology applications and integrated as one of the components of MGISPEC's functional system.

  • Helps provide strong UV protection to prevent frame yellowing (Main Advantage of the Rutile Type).
  • Provides photocatalytic self-cleaning technology and passive antibacterial effects (Advantage of the Anatase Type).
  • Provides high opacity to enhance the appearance of eyeglass frames.

A ceramic material known for its stability and excellent mechanical characteristics, supporting the formulation of frame materials designed for everyday use.

  • Provides very high resistance to wear, scratches, and whitish discoloration.

  1. NANO SILICA (SiO₂)

9 Advanced Lens Protection Features with Photochromic Technology

INTELLIGENT LENS TECHNOLOGY THAT ADAPTS TO LIGHT

MGISPEC introduces innovative Polycarbonate (PC) Photochromic Lens Technology, designed to combine optical clarity, visual comfort, material durability, and protective performance in one modern lens system.

Its distinctive feature is the ability to transition from clear to blue (Photochromic Blue) when exposed to sufficient ultraviolet (UV) light, gradually returning to clear as UV exposure decreases.

This adaptive technology offers convenience and flexibility for people who frequently move between indoor and outdoor environments.

9 ADVANCED LENS PROTECTION FEATURES

1. UVA Protection

Designed to help reduce the amount of ultraviolet A (UVA) radiation reaching the eyes. UVA radiation can penetrate ocular tissues, and excessive long-term exposure is associated with damage to certain eye structures.

UVA protection supports long-term eye health, particularly during outdoor activities.

2. UVB Protection

Helps block ultraviolet B (UVB) radiation, which can damage the surface of the eyes following excessive exposure.

This protective feature helps reduce UV-related eye risks, including photokeratitis, while supporting long-term ocular protection.

3. Scratch Resistant

Engineered to provide resistance against minor scratches associated with normal handling, cleaning, and daily use.

This feature helps preserve lens clarity, minimize visual disturbances caused by surface scratches, and maintain comfortable vision over time.

4. Impact Resistant

Polycarbonate (PC) is recognized for its good impact resistance compared with several conventional optical lens materials.

This property helps reduce the likelihood of lens breakage from certain everyday impacts and provides an additional measure of protection during daily activities. It does not make the lens unbreakable.

5. Explosion Resistant / Shatter Resistant

Designed with material characteristics that help reduce the likelihood of the lens breaking into sharp fragments under certain impact or pressure conditions.

This contributes to additional user safety. However, the lens should not be considered explosion-proof or suitable for high-velocity projectile protection without specific safety certification.

6. Oil Stain Resistant

The lens surface is designed to help resist the accumulation of oily fingerprints, grease, and everyday oil-based stains.

This feature makes cleaning more convenient and helps maintain a clearer field of vision throughout daily use.

7. Light and Magnetic Radiation Protection

The lens technology is designed to manage light transmission across selected wavelengths according to its optical filtering characteristics.

Selective light filtering may help reduce exposure to certain wavelengths and improve visual comfort. However, protection against magnetic fields or all forms of electromagnetic radiation requires specific testing and cannot be assumed from polycarbonate material alone.

8. Static Resistant

Incorporates a specialized electrostatic discharge coating process designed to reduce the accumulation of static electrical charges on the lens surface.

This technology may help minimize the attraction of airborne dust and fine particles caused by electrostatic forces, supporting a cleaner lens surface and more convenient maintenance.

9. Corrosion Resistant

Designed with material properties that provide resistance to certain environmental conditions and chemical exposures.

This feature helps maintain surface quality and supports lens durability during everyday use. Actual resistance depends on the chemical substance, temperature, and exposure conditions.

PHOTOCHROMIC BLUE – CLEAR-TO-BLUE COLOR TRANSITION

Photochromic Blue Technology allows the lenses to adapt their tint intensity in response to ultraviolet light exposure.

Indoors: The lenses remain relatively clear, supporting natural and comfortable vision.

Outdoors: When exposed to sufficient UV light, the lenses gradually develop a blue tint, helping reduce transmitted light intensity.

Returning indoors: The blue tint gradually fades as UV exposure decreases, allowing the lenses to return toward their clear state.

The speed and intensity of the color transition depend on UV exposure, temperature, and environmental conditions. Full activation may not occur behind UV-filtering vehicle windows.

MGISPEC CLINICAL TRIAL RESULTS

MGISPEC functional eyewear technology was evaluated in a prospective, randomized, parallel-controlled clinical trial at Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. The study involved 150 participants divided into three groups, with eyewear worn for at least 8 hours per day for 15 consecutive days.

After 15 days, the MGISPEC group recorded a visual-fatigue score of 12.23 ± 1.34, compared with 17.87 ± 2.11 in the ordinary optical-eyewear group and 15.15 ± 1.77 in the conventional blue-light-filtering group (P=0.002). The overall effectiveness rate for visual-acuity improvement reached 90%, while the overall relief rate for dry-eye symptoms reached 92%. No serious adverse events were reported.

Important: the clinical trial evaluated the MGISPEC eyewear technology as an integrated system—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared, and blue-light filtering—not each individual material as a stand-alone medical treatment. The material descriptions above therefore reflect material characteristics and potential mechanisms discussed in the clinical report.

From working with digital screens and reading to driving and enjoying outdoor activities, the MGISPEC PC47 Photochromic Series is designed as modern eyewear that combines visual comfort, light-adaptive performance, functional material technology, and multi-feature lens protection in one premium design.

HOW TO USE MGISPEC

Good vision plays an important role in supporting daily activities and overall quality of life. To promote comfortable use and help maintain eye health, please follow these guidelines:

Wear MGISPEC regularly for at least 8–10 hours per day, particularly during your daily activities.

If you have a high degree of myopia (nearsightedness), hyperopia (farsightedness), or astigmatism, it is recommended that you consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional. MGISPEC lenses can be replaced with prescription lenses tailored to your individual vision needs by a qualified optical professional or based on the recommendation of an ophthalmologist.

If you experience eye discomfort, eye-related symptoms, or changes in your vision, do not rely solely on wearing eyeglasses. You are advised to consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional for appropriate examination, evaluation, and treatment.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

MGISPEC products are not a substitute for professional medical examination, diagnosis, medication, or treatment. If you experience eye discomfort, vision problems, or have an existing eye condition, please consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional.

HOW TO TAKE CARE FOR YOUR MGISPEC

To help maintain the cleanliness, comfort, and overall condition of your MGISPEC eyewear, please follow these care instructions:

Fold the temples before placing down or storing your eyewear. Avoid placing the glasses with the front surface of the lenses directly against a table or any other surface to help prevent scratches.

Clean the lenses with clean water or a lens-cleaning solution specifically designed for eyeglasses. If oil, dust, perspiration, or other residue is difficult to remove, gently wipe the lenses with a clean, soft microfiber cloth.

Store your eyewear in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Under normal storage conditions, keep the product at a temperature between 0°C and 45°C.

Avoid prolonged exposure to extreme temperatures. Do not leave the product at temperatures below –10°C or above 45°C for extended periods, as extreme temperatures may cause deformation or changes in the shape of certain parts of the eyewear.

Use mild soap when necessary and clean the lenses with a soft microfiber cloth. Do not use tissues, paper towels, or other rough materials, as they may scratch the lens surface.

Avoid household cleaning products and alcohol. Clean your eyewear regularly to help prevent the accumulation of dust, oil, perspiration, and other residue.

12种先进功能材料

镜框与镜腿

  1. 黑碧玺（BLACK TOURMALINE）

黑碧玺是一种天然矿物，以其能够自然产生负离子及释放远红外线（FIR）的独特特性而闻名。

黑碧玺的两大主要功能：

  • 产生负离子： 有助于营造更加清新、舒适的环境。
  • 释放远红外线（FIR）： 能够自然释放波长处于4–14微米（µm）安全范围内的远红外能量。

在日常应用中的潜在益处：

  • 有助于提升眼部舒适度。
  • 有助于促进微循环。
  • 提供放松舒缓的效果。
  • 有助于提升长时间佩戴的舒适性。

在MGISPEC眼镜中，经过精细研磨的黑碧玺粉末被精准地融入镜框材料中，以充分发挥其负离子及远红外线功能。

  1. 负离子（NEGATIVE IONS）

负离子被誉为“空气中的维生素”，在帮助提升眼部舒适度及降低眼睛疲劳风险方面发挥着重要作用。

负离子在MGISPEC眼镜中的功能：

  • 有助于减轻长时间使用所引起的眼睛疲劳。
  • 专为提升日常活动中的眼部舒适度而设计，尤其适用于使用数码电子设备时。
  • 佩戴眼镜时，有助于让眼部感受到更加放松与舒适。
  • 有助于提升眼周及太阳穴区域的舒适度。

在MGISPEC临床报告中，负离子被列为潜在作用机制之一，其作用可能与中和自由基、减少氧化应激及调节自主神经系统有关，并可能有助于眼部肌肉放松及提升眼部舒适度。

  1. 远红外线（FAR-INFRARED / FIR）

远红外线（FIR）的安全波长范围为4–14 µm（微米）。

微米是一种用于测量极微小长度的单位。

  • 1微米（µm）= 0.001毫米（mm）。
  • 4 µm = 4,000纳米（nm）。
  • 14 µm = 14,000纳米（nm）。

因此，4–14 µm表示波长介于4,000至14,000纳米之间的红外线。

远红外线（FIR）：4–14 µm（4,000–14,000 nm）

远红外线（FIR）在MGISPEC眼镜中的益处：

  • 有助于改善受压部位的血液循环。
  • 有助于缓解眼周肌肉疲劳。
  • 有助于促进湿气的吸收与排出，减少闷热及黏腻感。
  • 提供辅助性的抗菌及除臭效果。
  • 有助于中和静电。

此外，MGISPEC临床报告指出，波长范围为4–14 µm的远红外线可能是一种潜在的作用机制，有助于促进毛细血管扩张，并改善睫状肌、视网膜及脉络膜的血液供应，从而可能支持眼部微循环、提升眼部舒适度及维持视觉功能。

MGISPEC 九大镜片防护功能

1. UVA Protection — UVA 长波紫外线防护

镜片设计旨在帮助减少进入眼睛的长波紫外线（UVA）。

长期过量接触 UVA 可能对眼部部分组织造成损伤。有效的 UVA 防护有助于降低紫外线暴露带来的潜在风险，为日常户外活动提供额外的眼部保护。

2. UVB Protection — UVB 中波紫外线防护

帮助阻挡中波紫外线（UVB），减少紫外线对眼睛表面组织的直接影响。

过量 UVB 照射可能引起光性角膜炎等眼部问题。镜片的 UVB 防护功能有助于降低相关风险，为长期眼部健康提供支持。

3. Scratch Resistant — 耐刮擦性能

镜片表面经过专门设计，能够抵抗日常使用、清洁及接触过程中产生的轻微刮擦。

有助于保持镜片的清晰度，减少表面划痕对视觉体验的影响，并延长镜片的正常使用寿命。

4. Impact Resistant — 抗冲击性能

聚碳酸酯（PC）材料相较于部分传统光学镜片材料，具有良好的抗冲击特性。

这种性能有助于降低日常碰撞造成镜片破裂的风险，为佩戴者提供额外的安全保障，但并不意味着镜片完全不会破损。

5. Explosion Resistant / Shatter Resistant — 抗碎裂性能

镜片材料具有一定的韧性，在特定冲击或压力条件下，有助于降低破裂并形成尖锐碎片的可能性。

该特性可进一步提升日常使用的安全性。但未经专门安全认证的镜片，不应被视为防爆镜片或高速飞射物防护镜片。

6. Oil Stain Resistant — 抗油污性能

镜片表面设计有助于减少油脂、指纹及日常油性污渍的附着。

使镜片更容易清洁，并有助于维持清晰视野，提升日常佩戴与保养的便利性。

7. Light and Magnetic Radiation Protection — 光线及电磁辐射防护

镜片可根据其光学过滤特性，对特定波长范围内的光线进行选择性过滤。

适当的光线过滤有助于减少某些波段的光线暴露，并提升视觉舒适度。

需要注意的是，对于磁场或所有类型电磁辐射的防护效果，必须通过专项测试验证，不能仅凭 PC 材料特性作出判断。

8. Static Resistant — 抗静电性能

采用专门的静电释放涂层工艺（Electrostatic Discharge Coating Process），旨在减少镜片表面静电荷的积聚。

该技术有助于降低因静电作用而吸附灰尘和细小颗粒的可能性，使镜片表面更易保持洁净，提升日常使用与清洁的便利性。

9. Corrosion Resistant — 耐腐蚀性能

镜片材料设计具有抵抗特定环境条件及化学物质影响的能力。

有助于保持镜片表面质量和材料稳定性，提升日常使用的耐用程度。实际耐腐蚀效果取决于接触物质、温度及使用环境。

PHOTOCHROMIC BLUE — 透明变蓝色智能感光技术

MGISPEC 智能变色蓝色镜片能够根据紫外线照射情况，自动调整镜片颜色深浅。

室内环境： 镜片通常保持较为透明的状态，提供自然、清晰的视觉体验。

户外环境： 当接触足够强度的紫外线时，镜片逐渐呈现蓝色色调，帮助降低透过镜片的光线强度。

返回室内： 随着紫外线照射减少，蓝色色调逐渐消退，镜片慢慢恢复透明。

镜片变色速度及颜色深浅会受到紫外线强度、环境温度等因素影响。在具有紫外线阻隔功能的汽车玻璃后方，镜片可能无法完全变色。

MGISPEC 临床试验结果

MGISPEC 功能眼镜科技已在天津华厦眼科医院进行前瞻性、随机、平行对照临床试验。研究共纳入 150 名受试者，分为三组，每天佩戴至少 8 小时，连续 15 天。

15 天后，MGISPEC 组视觉疲劳评分为 12.23 ± 1.34；普通光学眼镜组为 17.87 ± 2.11；传统蓝光过滤眼镜组为 15.15 ± 1.77（P=0.002）。视力改善总体有效率达到 90%，干眼症状总体缓解率达到 92%，且未报告严重不良事件。

重要说明：临床试验评估的是 MGISPEC 负离子、远红外与蓝光过滤功能眼镜的整体技术系统，而不是证明每一种材料单独具有医疗治疗效果。上述材料功能说明主要体现材料特性及临床报告中讨论的潜在作用机制。

避免使用家用清洁剂或酒精清洁眼镜。 请定期清洁眼镜，以帮助减少灰尘、油脂、汗渍及其他污垢的积聚。

  • 4 µm = 4.000 nanometer (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14.000 nanometer (nm).

Jadi, 4–14 µm berarti panjang gelombang inframerah antara 4.000 hingga 14.000 nanometer.

HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

Far-Infrared (FIR) has a safe wavelength range of 4–14 µm (micrometers).

A micrometer is a unit used to measure extremely small lengths.

  • 1 micrometer (µm) = 0.001 millimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4,000 nanometers (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14,000 nanometers (nm).

Therefore, 4–14 µm refers to infrared wavelengths ranging from 4,000 to 14,000 nanometers.

FIR 4–14 µm (4,000–14,000 nm)

MGISPEC CLINICAL TRIAL RESULTS

MGISPEC functional eyewear technology was evaluated in a prospective, randomized, parallel-controlled clinical trial at Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. The study involved 150 participants divided into three groups, with eyewear worn for at least 8 hours per day for 15 consecutive days.

After 15 days, the MGISPEC group recorded a visual-fatigue score of 12.23 ± 1.34, compared with 17.87 ± 2.11 in the ordinary optical-eyewear group and 15.15 ± 1.77 in the conventional blue-light-filtering group (P=0.002). The overall effectiveness rate for visual-acuity improvement reached 90%, while the overall relief rate for dry-eye symptoms reached 92%. No serious adverse events were reported.

主要功能性成分及其潜在益处：

  1. 黑碧玺（BLACK TOURMALINE）

黑碧玺是一种天然矿物，以其能够自然产生负离子及释放远红外线（FIR）的独特特性而闻名。

黑碧玺的两大主要功能：

  • 产生负离子： 有助于营造更加清新、舒适的环境。
  • 释放远红外线（FIR）： 能够自然释放波长处于4–14微米（µm）安全范围内的远红外能量。

在日常应用中的潜在益处：

  • 有助于提升眼部舒适度。
  • 有助于促进微循环。
  • 提供放松舒缓的效果。
  • 有助于提升长时间佩戴的舒适性。

在MGISPEC眼镜中，经过精细研磨的黑碧玺粉末被精准地融入镜框材料中，以充分发挥其负离子及远红外线功能。

  1. 负离子（NEGATIVE IONS）

负离子被誉为“空气中的维生素”，在帮助提升眼部舒适度及降低眼睛疲劳风险方面发挥着重要作用。

负离子在MGISPEC眼镜中的功能：

  • 有助于减轻长时间使用所引起的眼睛疲劳。
  • 专为提升日常活动中的眼部舒适度而设计，尤其适用于使用数码电子设备时。
  • 佩戴眼镜时，有助于让眼部感受到更加放松与舒适。
  • 有助于提升眼周及太阳穴区域的舒适度。

在MGISPEC临床报告中，负离子被列为潜在作用机制之一，其作用可能与中和自由基、减少氧化应激及调节自主神经系统有关，并可能有助于眼部肌肉放松及提升眼部舒适度。

  1. 远红外线（FAR-INFRARED / FIR）

远红外线（FIR）的安全波长范围为4–14 µm（微米）。

微米是一种用于测量极微小长度的单位。

  • 1微米（µm）= 0.001毫米（mm）。
  • 4 µm = 4,000纳米（nm）。
  • 14 µm = 14,000纳米（nm）。

因此，4–14 µm表示波长介于4,000至14,000纳米之间的红外线。

远红外线（FIR）：4–14 µm（4,000–14,000 nm）

远红外线（FIR）在MGISPEC眼镜中的益处：

  • 有助于改善受压部位的血液循环。
  • 有助于缓解眼周肌肉疲劳。
  • 有助于促进湿气的吸收与排出，减少闷热及黏腻感。
  • 提供辅助性的抗菌及除臭效果。
  • 有助于中和静电。

此外，MGISPEC临床报告指出，波长范围为4–14 µm的远红外线可能是一种潜在的作用机制，有助于促进毛细血管扩张，并改善睫状肌、视网膜及脉络膜的血液供应，从而可能支持眼部微循环、提升眼部舒适度及维持视觉功能。

  1. 纳米银（NANO SILVER）

一种具有强效、广谱抗菌、抗病毒及抗真菌能力的材料技术。

在材料科学领域，银在特定应用及配方中具有公认的抗微生物特性。在MGISPEC眼镜中，纳米银作为纳米材料技术的一部分，被应用于镜框及镜腿材料系统中。

  1. 锗（GERMANIUM / Ge）

一种具有半导体特性的功能性材料技术，与其他矿物成分相结合，构成MGISPEC综合材料系统的一部分。

  • 有助于调节人体微弱生物电流，以缓解神经紧张。

  • 有助于提供抗菌方面的舒适体验，并降低皮肤过敏风险。

  1. 石墨烯（GRAPHENE）

一种先进的碳基功能性材料技术，具有高强度、轻量化以及优异的物理和导热特性。

  • 有助于快速散热，减少闷热及黏腻感（核心优势）。

九项镜片防护与耐用性功能

PC 蓝色镀膜太阳镜镜片

MGISPEC SG013 采用聚碳酸酯（PC）太阳镜镜片，搭配优雅的蓝色镀膜设计，将高端美学与九项防护及耐用性功能相结合。

1. UVA Protection – UVA 紫外线防护

镜片设计旨在帮助减少紫外线A波段（UVA）的照射。长期过量接触UVA可能对眼部组织造成不良影响。

眼部健康益处： 在户外活动中帮助减少有害紫外线暴露，为眼部健康提供防护支持。

2. UVB Protection – UVB 紫外线防护

帮助减少紫外线B波段（UVB）的照射。过量UVB可能对角膜等眼表组织造成损伤。

眼部健康益处： 帮助保护眼部组织免受过量UVB照射，并支持长期眼部健康。

3. Scratch Resistant – 抗刮擦性能

镜片表面经过特殊设计，以提高日常使用过程中对轻微刮擦的抵抗能力。

益处： 有助于保持镜片清晰度，维持舒适的视觉体验。

4. Impact Resistant – 抗冲击性能

聚碳酸酯材料相较于部分传统镜片材料，具有良好的抗冲击特性。

益处： 有助于降低正常使用过程中因碰撞而造成镜片损坏的风险。

5. Explosion Resistant – 抗碎裂性能

镜片材料经过设计，有助于降低在特定冲击条件下破裂成尖锐碎片的可能性。

益处： 相较于容易碎裂的镜片材料，可提供更好的材料安全特性，但极端冲击仍可能造成损坏。

6. Oil Stain Resistant – 抗油污性能

特殊镜片表面有助于减少油脂、指纹及部分污渍的附着。

益处： 使日常清洁更加方便，并有助于保持镜片清晰，提升视觉舒适度。

7. Light and Magnetic Radiation Protection – 光线及磁辐射防护

太阳镜镜片设计旨在降低进入眼睛的可见光强度。

益处： 有助于减少强光造成的眩光，并提升明亮环境下的视觉舒适度。磁辐射防护属于独立的技术声明，需要专门的测试证据支持。

8. Static Resistant – 抗静电性能

采用特殊镀膜工艺，以支持镜片表面的静电释放（Electrostatic Discharge，ESD）功能。

益处： 有助于减少静电荷积聚，并使镜片表面更易于日常维护。

9. Corrosion Resistant – 耐腐蚀性能

镜片镀膜设计旨在提升对环境因素及正常使用过程中接触某些物质的耐受能力。

益处： 有助于维持镜片表面质量，并支持长期使用的耐用性。

MGISPEC 临床试验结果

MGISPEC 功能眼镜科技已在天津华厦眼科医院进行前瞻性、随机、平行对照临床试验。研究共纳入 150 名受试者，分为三组，每天佩戴至少 8 小时，连续 15 天。

15 天后，MGISPEC 组视觉疲劳评分为 12.23 ± 1.34；普通光学眼镜组为 17.87 ± 2.11；传统蓝光过滤眼镜组为 15.15 ± 1.77（P=0.002）。视力改善总体有效率达到 90%，干眼症状总体缓解率达到 92%，且未报告严重不良事件。

重要说明：临床试验评估的是 MGISPEC 负离子、远红外与蓝光过滤功能眼镜的整体技术系统，而不是证明每一种材料单独具有医疗治疗效果。上述材料功能说明主要体现材料特性及临床报告中讨论的潜在作用机制。

MGISPEC 使用指南

良好的视力对于日常生活、工作以及整体生活质量都十分重要。为了提升佩戴舒适度并帮助维护眼部健康，请遵循以下使用建议：

  1. 建议每天规律佩戴 MGISPEC 至少 8–10 小时，尤其是在进行日常活动时。
  2. 如果您有较高度数的近视、远视或散光，建议咨询眼科医生或专业视光人员。MGISPEC 镜片可根据您的实际视力需求，通过专业眼镜店或依据眼科医生的建议，更换为适合您个人视力需求的处方镜片。
  3. 如果您出现眼部不适、眼部症状或视力变化，请勿仅依赖佩戴眼镜。建议及时咨询眼科医生或专业视光人员，进行适当的检查、评估及治疗。

重要提示

MGISPEC 产品不能替代专业的医学检查、诊断、药物或医疗治疗。如果您出现眼部不适、视力问题，或患有其他眼部疾病，请咨询眼科医生或专业视光人员。

MGISPEC 保养指南

为了帮助保持 MGISPEC 眼镜的清洁、舒适度及良好状态，请遵循以下保养方法：

  1. 放置或收纳眼镜前，请先折叠镜腿。 请避免将镜片正面直接朝下放置在桌面或其他表面上，以帮助防止镜片刮伤。
  2. 请使用清水或眼镜镜片专用清洁液清洁镜片。 如果镜片上的油脂、灰尘、汗渍或其他污渍难以清除，请使用干净、柔软的超细纤维布轻轻擦拭。
  3. 请将眼镜存放在阴凉、干燥的环境中，并避免阳光直射。正常存放温度建议保持在 0°C 至 45°C 之间。
  4. 避免长时间暴露于极端温度环境中。 请勿将产品长时间置于 –10°C 以下或 45°C 以上的环境中，因为极端温度可能导致眼镜的某些部件发生变形或形状变化。
  5. 必要时可使用温和的肥皂清洁，并使用柔软的超细纤维布擦拭镜片。 请勿使用纸巾、纸巾类清洁用品或其他粗糙材质擦拭镜片，以免刮伤镜片表面。

MGISPEC SG09 menggunakan Polycarbonate (PC) Progressive Tint Lenses, yaitu lensa polikarbonat dengan gradasi warna yang dirancang untuk memberikan kenyamanan visual sekaligus tampilan yang elegan.

Lensa ini dilengkapi dengan spesifikasi perlindungan berikut:

Membantu melindungi mata dari sinar ultraviolet B yang dapat menyebabkan gangguan pada permukaan mata akibat paparan berlebihan.

Dirancang untuk meningkatkan ketahanan permukaan lensa terhadap goresan ringan dalam penggunaan normal, sehingga membantu mempertahankan kualitas penglihatan dan kejernihan lensa.

4. Impact Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Benturan

Material polikarbonat memiliki karakteristik tahan benturan yang baik dibandingkan sejumlah material lensa konvensional, sehingga membantu meningkatkan keamanan penggunaan sehari-hari.

5. Explosion Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Pecah akibat Benturan

Mengacu pada kemampuan material lensa untuk mengurangi risiko pecah atau retak akibat benturan dalam kondisi pengujian tertentu. Fitur ini tidak berarti lensa sepenuhnya tidak dapat pecah.

Membantu mengurangi penempelan noda minyak dan sidik jari pada permukaan lensa sehingga mempermudah pembersihan dan perawatan.

7. Light & Magnetic Radiation Protection – Perlindungan terhadap Cahaya dan Radiasi Magnetik

Spesifikasi ini berkaitan dengan konsep perlindungan terhadap paparan cahaya tertentu dan radiasi elektromagnetik. Kemampuan perlindungan terhadap radiasi magnetik memerlukan hasil pengujian khusus untuk memastikan efektivitasnya.

8. Static Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Listrik Statis

Menggunakan proses pelapisan yang dirancang untuk membantu pelepasan muatan elektrostatis pada permukaan lensa, sehingga dapat membantu mengurangi penumpukan muatan statis.

9. Corrosion Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Korosi

Dirancang untuk meningkatkan ketahanan material atau lapisan terhadap pengaruh lingkungan tertentu, membantu menjaga kualitas lensa selama pemakaian dan perawatan yang sesuai.

HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

MGISPEC SG09 is developed using nano technology, incorporating the concept of 12 integrated functional materials within the frame and temples.

This innovative material system is designed to combine advanced material science, wearing comfort, and MGISPEC's eye-wellness philosophy.

Key components of the MGISPEC functional material system include:

1. BLACK TOURMALINE

Black Tourmaline is a natural mineral known for its unique properties in naturally generating Negative Ions and emitting Far-Infrared (FIR) radiation.

Two Main Functions of Black Tourmaline:

  • Negative Ion Generation: Helps create a fresher and more comfortable environment.
  • Far-Infrared (FIR) Emission: Naturally emits far-infrared energy within the safe wavelength range of 4–14 micrometers (µm).

Potential Benefits in Everyday Applications:

  • Supports eye comfort.
  • Helps support microcirculation.
  • Provides a relaxing effect.
  • Supports comfort during prolonged wear.

In MGISPEC, finely powdered Black Tourmaline is precisely integrated into the frame material to optimize its Negative Ion and FIR functions.

2. NEGATIVE IONS

Negative Ions are often referred to as "Vitamins in the Air" and play an important role in supporting eye comfort and reducing the risk of eye fatigue.

Functions of Negative Ions in MGISPEC:

  • Help reduce eye fatigue caused by prolonged use.
  • Designed to support eye comfort during daily activities, particularly when using digital devices.
  • Help provide a more relaxed and comfortable sensation around the eyes while wearing the glasses.
  • Support comfort around the eye and temple areas.

In the MGISPEC clinical report, Negative Ions are discussed as one of the potential mechanisms associated with free-radical neutralization, reduction of oxidative stress, and autonomic regulation, which may contribute to ocular muscle relaxation and eye comfort.

  1. FAR-INFRARED (FIR)

Far-Infrared (FIR) has a safe wavelength range of 4–14 µm (micrometers).

A micrometer is a unit used to measure extremely small lengths.

  • 1 micrometer (µm) = 0.001 millimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4,000 nanometers (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14,000 nanometers (nm).

Therefore, 4–14 µm refers to infrared wavelengths ranging from 4,000 to 14,000 nanometers.

FIR 4–14 µm (4,000–14,000 nm)

Benefits of Far-Infrared (FIR) in MGISPEC:

  • Helps improve blood circulation in areas subjected to pressure.
  • Helps relieve muscle fatigue around the eyes.
  • Helps facilitate moisture absorption and release to reduce feelings of heat and stickiness.
  • Provides supplementary antibacterial and deodorizing effects.
  • Helps neutralize static electricity.

Furthermore, FIR within the 4–14 µm wavelength range is discussed in the MGISPEC clinical report as a potential mechanism that may support capillary dilation and blood supply to the ciliary muscles, retina, and choroid, thereby potentially supporting ocular microcirculation, comfort, and visual function.

纳米科技与12种功能性材料

MGISPEC SG09 采用纳米科技研发，并融入镜框及镜腿中12种功能性材料的整合设计理念。

这一创新材料系统结合现代材料科学、佩戴舒适性及 MGISPEC 所倡导的眼部健康理念，致力于打造兼具科技感与舒适体验的高品质眼镜。

MGISPEC 功能性材料系统的主要成分包括：

  1. 黑碧玺（BLACK TOURMALINE）

黑碧玺是一种天然矿物，以其能够自然产生负离子及释放远红外线（FIR）的独特特性而闻名。

黑碧玺的两大主要功能：

  • 产生负离子： 有助于营造更加清新、舒适的环境。
  • 释放远红外线（FIR）： 能够自然释放波长处于4–14微米（µm）安全范围内的远红外能量。

在日常应用中的潜在益处：

  • 有助于提升眼部舒适度。
  • 有助于促进微循环。
  • 提供放松舒缓的效果。
  • 有助于提升长时间佩戴的舒适性。

在MGISPEC眼镜中，经过精细研磨的黑碧玺粉末被精准地融入镜框材料中，以充分发挥其负离子及远红外线功能。

  1. 负离子（NEGATIVE IONS）

负离子被誉为“空气中的维生素”，在帮助提升眼部舒适度及降低眼睛疲劳风险方面发挥着重要作用。

负离子在MGISPEC眼镜中的功能：

  • 有助于减轻长时间使用所引起的眼睛疲劳。
  • 专为提升日常活动中的眼部舒适度而设计，尤其适用于使用数码电子设备时。
  • 佩戴眼镜时，有助于让眼部感受到更加放松与舒适。
  • 有助于提升眼周及太阳穴区域的舒适度。

在MGISPEC临床报告中，负离子被列为潜在作用机制之一，其作用可能与中和自由基、减少氧化应激及调节自主神经系统有关，并可能有助于眼部肌肉放松及提升眼部舒适度。

  1. 远红外线（FAR-INFRARED / FIR）

远红外线（FIR）的安全波长范围为4–14 µm（微米）。

微米是一种用于测量极微小长度的单位。

  • 1微米（µm）= 0.001毫米（mm）。
  • 4 µm = 4,000纳米（nm）。
  • 14 µm = 14,000纳米（nm）。

因此，4–14 µm表示波长介于4,000至14,000纳米之间的红外线。

远红外线（FIR）：4–14 µm（4,000–14,000 nm）

远红外线（FIR）在MGISPEC眼镜中的益处：

  • 有助于改善受压部位的血液循环。
  • 有助于缓解眼周肌肉疲劳。
  • 有助于促进湿气的吸收与排出，减少闷热及黏腻感。
  • 提供辅助性的抗菌及除臭效果。
  • 有助于中和静电。

此外，MGISPEC临床报告指出，波长范围为4–14 µm的远红外线可能是一种潜在的作用机制，有助于促进毛细血管扩张，并改善睫状肌、视网膜及脉络膜的血液供应，从而可能支持眼部微循环、提升眼部舒适度及维持视觉功能。

在材料科学领域，银在特定应用及配方中具有公认的抗微生物特性。在MGISPEC眼镜中，纳米银作为纳米材料技术的一部分，被应用于镜框及镜腿材料系统中。

  1. 锗（GERMANIUM / Ge）

一种具有半导体特性的功能性材料技术，与其他矿物成分相结合，构成MGISPEC综合材料系统的一部分。

MGISPEC 临床试验结果

MGISPEC 功能眼镜科技已在天津华厦眼科医院进行前瞻性、随机、平行对照临床试验。研究共纳入 150 名受试者，分为三组，每天佩戴至少 8 小时，连续 15 天。

15 天后，MGISPEC 组视觉疲劳评分为 12.23 ± 1.34；普通光学眼镜组为 17.87 ± 2.11；传统蓝光过滤眼镜组为 15.15 ± 1.77（P=0.002）。视力改善总体有效率达到 90%，干眼症状总体缓解率达到 92%，且未报告严重不良事件。

重要说明：临床试验评估的是 MGISPEC 负离子、远红外与蓝光过滤功能眼镜的整体技术系统，而不是证明每一种材料单独具有医疗治疗效果。上述材料功能说明主要体现材料特性及临床报告中讨论的潜在作用机制。

MGISPEC 使用指南

良好的视力对于日常生活、工作以及整体生活质量都十分重要。为了提升佩戴舒适度并帮助维护眼部健康，请遵循以下使用建议：

  1. 建议每天规律佩戴 MGISPEC 至少 8–10 小时，尤其是在进行日常活动时。
  2. 如果您有较高度数的近视、远视或散光，建议咨询眼科医生或专业视光人员。MGISPEC 镜片可根据您的实际视力需求，通过专业眼镜店或依据眼科医生的建议，更换为适合您个人视力需求的处方镜片。
  3. 如果您出现眼部不适、眼部症状或视力变化，请勿仅依赖佩戴眼镜。建议及时咨询眼科医生或专业视光人员，进行适当的检查、评估及治疗。

重要提示

MGISPEC 产品不能替代专业的医学检查、诊断、药物或医疗治疗。如果您出现眼部不适、视力问题，或患有其他眼部疾病，请咨询眼科医生或专业视光人员。

MGISPEC 保养指南

为了帮助保持 MGISPEC 眼镜的清洁、舒适度及良好状态，请遵循以下保养方法：

  1. 放置或收纳眼镜前，请先折叠镜腿。 请避免将镜片正面直接朝下放置在桌面或其他表面上，以帮助防止镜片刮伤。
  2. 请使用清水或眼镜镜片专用清洁液清洁镜片。 如果镜片上的油脂、灰尘、汗渍或其他污渍难以清除，请使用干净、柔软的超细纤维布轻轻擦拭。
  3. 请将眼镜存放在阴凉、干燥的环境中，并避免阳光直射。正常存放温度建议保持在 0°C 至 45°C 之间。

TEKNOLOGI LENSA & 9 FITUR PERLINDUNGAN

MGISPEC SG09 menggunakan Polycarbonate (PC) Progressive Tint Lenses, yaitu lensa polikarbonat dengan gradasi warna yang dirancang untuk memberikan kenyamanan visual sekaligus tampilan yang elegan.

Lensa ini dilengkapi dengan spesifikasi perlindungan berikut:

1. UVA Protection – Perlindungan Sinar UVA

Membantu mengurangi paparan sinar ultraviolet A pada mata. Perlindungan UV penting karena paparan ultraviolet berlebihan dalam jangka panjang dapat meningkatkan risiko kerusakan pada jaringan mata.

2. UVB Protection – Perlindungan Sinar UVB

Membantu melindungi mata dari sinar ultraviolet B yang dapat menyebabkan gangguan pada permukaan mata akibat paparan berlebihan.

3. Scratch Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Goresan

Dirancang untuk meningkatkan ketahanan permukaan lensa terhadap goresan ringan dalam penggunaan normal, sehingga membantu mempertahankan kualitas penglihatan dan kejernihan lensa.

4. Impact Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Benturan

Material polikarbonat memiliki karakteristik tahan benturan yang baik dibandingkan sejumlah material lensa konvensional, sehingga membantu meningkatkan keamanan penggunaan sehari-hari.

5. Explosion Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Pecah akibat Benturan

Mengacu pada kemampuan material lensa untuk mengurangi risiko pecah atau retak akibat benturan dalam kondisi pengujian tertentu. Fitur ini tidak berarti lensa sepenuhnya tidak dapat pecah.

6. Oil Stain Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Noda Minyak

Membantu mengurangi penempelan noda minyak dan sidik jari pada permukaan lensa sehingga mempermudah pembersihan dan perawatan.

7. Light & Magnetic Radiation Protection – Perlindungan terhadap Cahaya dan Radiasi Magnetik

Spesifikasi ini berkaitan dengan konsep perlindungan terhadap paparan cahaya tertentu dan radiasi elektromagnetik. Kemampuan perlindungan terhadap radiasi magnetik memerlukan hasil pengujian khusus untuk memastikan efektivitasnya.

8. Static Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Listrik Statis

Menggunakan proses pelapisan yang dirancang untuk membantu pelepasan muatan elektrostatis pada permukaan lensa, sehingga dapat membantu mengurangi penumpukan muatan statis.

9. Corrosion Resistant – Ketahanan terhadap Korosi

Dirancang untuk meningkatkan ketahanan material atau lapisan terhadap pengaruh lingkungan tertentu, membantu menjaga kualitas lensa selama pemakaian dan perawatan yang sesuai.

HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

MGISPEC SG09 is developed using nano technology, incorporating the concept of 12 integrated functional materials within the frame and temples.

This innovative material system is designed to combine advanced material science, wearing comfort, and MGISPEC's eye-wellness philosophy.

Key components of the MGISPEC functional material system include:

1. BLACK TOURMALINE

Black Tourmaline is a natural mineral known for its unique properties in naturally generating Negative Ions and emitting Far-Infrared (FIR) radiation.

Two Main Functions of Black Tourmaline:

  • Negative Ion Generation: Helps create a fresher and more comfortable environment.
  • Far-Infrared (FIR) Emission: Naturally emits far-infrared energy within the safe wavelength range of 4–14 micrometers (µm).

Potential Benefits in Everyday Applications:

  • Supports eye comfort.
  • Helps support microcirculation.
  • Provides a relaxing effect.
  • Supports comfort during prolonged wear.

In MGISPEC, finely powdered Black Tourmaline is precisely integrated into the frame material to optimize its Negative Ion and FIR functions.

2. NEGATIVE IONS

Negative Ions are often referred to as "Vitamins in the Air" and play an important role in supporting eye comfort and reducing the risk of eye fatigue.

Functions of Negative Ions in MGISPEC:

  • Help reduce eye fatigue caused by prolonged use.
  • Designed to support eye comfort during daily activities, particularly when using digital devices.
  • Help provide a more relaxed and comfortable sensation around the eyes while wearing the glasses.
  • Support comfort around the eye and temple areas.

In the MGISPEC clinical report, Negative Ions are discussed as one of the potential mechanisms associated with free-radical neutralization, reduction of oxidative stress, and autonomic regulation, which may contribute to ocular muscle relaxation and eye comfort.

  1. FAR-INFRARED (FIR)

Far-Infrared (FIR) has a safe wavelength range of 4–14 µm (micrometers).

A micrometer is a unit used to measure extremely small lengths.

  • 1 micrometer (µm) = 0.001 millimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4,000 nanometers (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14,000 nanometers (nm).

Therefore, 4–14 µm refers to infrared wavelengths ranging from 4,000 to 14,000 nanometers.

FIR 4–14 µm (4,000–14,000 nm)

Benefits of Far-Infrared (FIR) in MGISPEC:

  • Helps improve blood circulation in areas subjected to pressure.
  • Helps relieve muscle fatigue around the eyes.
  • Helps facilitate moisture absorption and release to reduce feelings of heat and stickiness.
  • Provides supplementary antibacterial and deodorizing effects.
  • Helps neutralize static electricity.

Furthermore, FIR within the 4–14 µm wavelength range is discussed in the MGISPEC clinical report as a potential mechanism that may support capillary dilation and blood supply to the ciliary muscles, retina, and choroid, thereby potentially supporting ocular microcirculation, comfort, and visual function.

MGISPEC CLINICAL TRIAL RESULTS

MGISPEC functional eyewear technology was evaluated in a prospective, randomized, parallel-controlled clinical trial at Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. The study involved 150 participants divided into three groups, with eyewear worn for at least 8 hours per day for 15 consecutive days.

After 15 days, the MGISPEC group recorded a visual-fatigue score of 12.23 ± 1.34, compared with 17.87 ± 2.11 in the ordinary optical-eyewear group and 15.15 ± 1.77 in the conventional blue-light-filtering group (P=0.002). The overall effectiveness rate for visual-acuity improvement reached 90%, while the overall relief rate for dry-eye symptoms reached 92%. No serious adverse events were reported.

纳米科技与12种功能性材料

MGISPEC SG09 采用纳米科技研发，并融入镜框及镜腿中12种功能性材料的整合设计理念。

这一创新材料系统结合现代材料科学、佩戴舒适性及 MGISPEC 所倡导的眼部健康理念，致力于打造兼具科技感与舒适体验的高品质眼镜。

MGISPEC 功能性材料系统的主要成分包括：

  1. 黑碧玺（BLACK TOURMALINE）

黑碧玺是一种天然矿物，以其能够自然产生负离子及释放远红外线（FIR）的独特特性而闻名。

黑碧玺的两大主要功能：

  • 产生负离子： 有助于营造更加清新、舒适的环境。
  • 释放远红外线（FIR）： 能够自然释放波长处于4–14微米（µm）安全范围内的远红外能量。

在日常应用中的潜在益处：

  • 有助于提升眼部舒适度。
  • 有助于促进微循环。
  • 提供放松舒缓的效果。
  • 有助于提升长时间佩戴的舒适性。

在MGISPEC眼镜中，经过精细研磨的黑碧玺粉末被精准地融入镜框材料中，以充分发挥其负离子及远红外线功能。

  1. 负离子（NEGATIVE IONS）

负离子被誉为“空气中的维生素”，在帮助提升眼部舒适度及降低眼睛疲劳风险方面发挥着重要作用。

负离子在MGISPEC眼镜中的功能：

  • 有助于减轻长时间使用所引起的眼睛疲劳。
  • 专为提升日常活动中的眼部舒适度而设计，尤其适用于使用数码电子设备时。
  • 佩戴眼镜时，有助于让眼部感受到更加放松与舒适。
  • 有助于提升眼周及太阳穴区域的舒适度。

在MGISPEC临床报告中，负离子被列为潜在作用机制之一，其作用可能与中和自由基、减少氧化应激及调节自主神经系统有关，并可能有助于眼部肌肉放松及提升眼部舒适度。

  1. 远红外线（FAR-INFRARED / FIR）

远红外线（FIR）的安全波长范围为4–14 µm（微米）。

微米是一种用于测量极微小长度的单位。

  • 1微米（µm）= 0.001毫米（mm）。
  • 4 µm = 4,000纳米（nm）。
  • 14 µm = 14,000纳米（nm）。

因此，4–14 µm表示波长介于4,000至14,000纳米之间的红外线。

远红外线（FIR）：4–14 µm（4,000–14,000 nm）

远红外线（FIR）在MGISPEC眼镜中的益处：

  • 有助于改善受压部位的血液循环。
  • 有助于缓解眼周肌肉疲劳。
  • 有助于促进湿气的吸收与排出，减少闷热及黏腻感。
  • 提供辅助性的抗菌及除臭效果。
  • 有助于中和静电。

此外，MGISPEC临床报告指出，波长范围为4–14 µm的远红外线可能是一种潜在的作用机制，有助于促进毛细血管扩张，并改善睫状肌、视网膜及脉络膜的血液供应，从而可能支持眼部微循环、提升眼部舒适度及维持视觉功能。

  1. 纳米银（NANO SILVER）

一种具有强效、广谱抗菌、抗病毒及抗真菌能力的材料技术。

在材料科学领域，银在特定应用及配方中具有公认的抗微生物特性。在MGISPEC眼镜中，纳米银作为纳米材料技术的一部分，被应用于镜框及镜腿材料系统中。

  1. 锗（GERMANIUM / Ge）

一种具有半导体特性的功能性材料技术，与其他矿物成分相结合，构成MGISPEC综合材料系统的一部分。

  • 有助于调节人体微弱生物电流，以缓解神经紧张。
  • 有助于增强远红外线（FIR）的共振作用，支持局部微循环。
  • 有助于产生微量负离子，以中和电磁静电。
  • 有助于提供抗菌方面的舒适体验，并降低皮肤过敏风险。
  • 有助于维持温度稳定，并减少因出汗而产生的湿气。
  • 有助于发挥良好的抗氧化作用。
  1. 石墨烯（GRAPHENE）

一种先进的碳基功能性材料技术，具有高强度、轻量化以及优异的物理和导热特性。

  • 有助于快速散热，减少闷热及黏腻感（核心优势）。
  • 支持远红外线（FIR）功能，有助于减少眼周压痕及不适感。

  1. 竹炭（BAMBOO CHARCOAL）

  1. 功能性矿物复合配方（FUNCTIONAL MINERAL BLEND）

由多种精选矿物组合而成，旨在作为一体化材料系统的一部分协同发挥作用，并支持MGISPEC所含各项成分的功能。

  1. 氧化锌（ZINC OXIDE / ZnO）

氧化锌因其稳定性及功能特性而广泛应用于材料技术领域，同时也是MGISPEC纳米材料配方的组成部分。

一种以良好稳定性及优异机械性能著称的陶瓷材料，可支持专为日常使用而设计的镜框材料配方。

  1. 纳米二氧化硅（NANO SILICA / SiO₂）
