HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

CARA MENGGUNAKAN MGISPEC

Penglihatan yang baik merupakan bagian penting dalam menunjang aktivitas dan kualitas hidup sehari-hari. Untuk mendukung kenyamanan penggunaan dan membantu menjaga kesehatan mata, perhatikan panduan berikut:

  1. Gunakan MGISPEC secara rutin selama minimal 8–10 jam per hari, terutama saat menjalani aktivitas sehari-hari.
  2. Apabila Anda memiliki kelainan refraksi dengan ukuran minus, plus, atau silinder yang tinggi, disarankan untuk berkonsultasi dengan dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata. Lensa MGISPEC dapat diganti dengan lensa resep yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan penglihatan Anda melalui optik profesional atau berdasarkan rekomendasi dokter mata.
  3. Apabila Anda mengalami keluhan pada mata atau perubahan pada penglihatan, jangan hanya mengandalkan penggunaan kacamata. Tetap disarankan untuk memeriksakan kondisi mata kepada dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata guna mendapatkan pemeriksaan dan penanganan yang sesuai.

PERHATIAN

Produk MGISPEC bukan merupakan pengganti pemeriksaan, diagnosis, obat-obatan, maupun perawatan medis profesional. Apabila Anda memiliki keluhan, gangguan penglihatan, atau kondisi kesehatan mata tertentu, konsultasikan dengan dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata.

CARA MERAWAT MGISPEC

Untuk membantu menjaga kebersihan, kenyamanan, dan kondisi kacamata MGISPEC agar tetap optimal, ikuti petunjuk perawatan berikut:

  1. Lipat tangkai kacamata sebelum meletakkan atau menyimpannya. Hindari meletakkan kacamata dengan permukaan depan lensa menghadap langsung ke meja atau permukaan lainnya untuk membantu mencegah goresan.
  2. Bersihkan lensa menggunakan air bersih atau cairan pembersih khusus lensa kacamata. Apabila terdapat minyak, debu, keringat, atau kotoran yang sulit dibersihkan, usap lensa secara perlahan menggunakan kain mikrofiber yang bersih dan lembut.
  3. Simpan kacamata di tempat yang sejuk dan kering, serta terlindung dari paparan sinar matahari langsung. Untuk penyimpanan normal, simpan pada suhu antara 0°C hingga 45°C.
  4. Hindari paparan suhu ekstrem dalam waktu lama. Jangan membiarkan produk berada pada suhu di bawah –10°C atau di atas 45°C dalam waktu yang berkepanjangan karena dapat menyebabkan perubahan bentuk atau deformasi pada bagian tertentu dari kacamata.
  5. Gunakan sabun yang lembut. Gunakan kain microfiber. (Jangan gunakan tisu atau bahan kain lain yang kasar.),
  6. Hindari penggunaan pembersih rumah tangga dan alkohol, Bersihkan kacamata secara rutin.
MGI-UT157-RED.en:
MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES

Beyond Vision. Beyond Protection.

LIGHTWEIGHT. FLEXIBLE. STRONG. ELEGANT.

ADVANCED MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY FOR ALL-DAY COMFORT

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES introduces premium eyewear innovation combining high-performance ULTEM material, nano technology, ergonomic design, and Advanced Functional Frame & Lens Technology to create an exceptional balance of comfort, durability, eye protection, and elegant style.

Featuring a modern and sophisticated round-frame design, MGISPEC UT157 is developed to complement various activities, including working, studying, using digital devices, traveling, and everyday routines.

With its lightweight, flexible, strong, and comfortable construction, MGISPEC UT157 is an ideal choice for individuals who value quality, technology, and professional appearance.

WHAT IS ULTEM MATERIAL?

ADVANCED HIGH-PERFORMANCE MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY ALSO USED IN THE AEROSPACE INDUSTRY

ULTEM (Polyetherimide/PEI) is a high-performance engineering thermoplastic recognized for its exceptional combination of lightweight construction, mechanical strength, dimensional stability, design flexibility, and high-temperature resistance.

These outstanding properties make ULTEM an important engineering material used across various high-technology industries, including the aviation and aerospace industry.

In aerospace applications, ULTEM is used in selected components, including aircraft interior parts, electrical components, and specialized engineering applications requiring lightweight, strong, stable materials that meet stringent safety requirements.

Its use in the aerospace industry demonstrates the advanced engineering value of this material, particularly in applications where weight efficiency, mechanical durability, and material performance are essential.

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES brings the advantages of this high-performance material technology into modern eyewear, combining lightweight construction, flexibility, durability, and exceptional everyday wearing comfort.

FROM AEROSPACE MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY TO PREMIUM MGISPEC EYEWEAR.

6 KEY ADVANTAGES OF ULTEM MATERIAL

1. EXTREMELY LIGHTWEIGHT

ULTEM enables the production of lightweight eyewear frames without compromising structural strength.

Its reduced weight helps minimize pressure on the nose and ears, enhancing comfort during extended wear.

2. STRONG & DURABLE

ULTEM provides excellent mechanical strength and durability for everyday use.

These characteristics help maintain frame stability and contribute to long-lasting product performance with appropriate use and care.

3. EXCELLENT FLEXIBILITY

ULTEM allows eyewear frames to be engineered with flexibility that supports everyday wearing comfort.

Properly designed flexibility helps reduce the risk of damage from minor stresses during normal activities.

4. HEAT & STEAM RESISTANT

ULTEM is an engineering material recognized for its high thermal resistance.

Certain ULTEM grades can be used in applications requiring resistance to temperatures of approximately 170°C, depending on the material grade, exposure duration, and testing conditions.

This characteristic helps maintain frame stability under normal temperature variations. However, eyewear should still be protected from direct exposure to extreme heat.

5. SKIN-FRIENDLY COMFORT

When properly processed, ULTEM can provide a smooth frame surface that feels comfortable against the skin.

Its lightweight design helps reduce pressure around the nose and ears during extended wear. Suitability for sensitive skin depends on the specific product formulation and individual conditions.

6. IDEAL FOR EVERYDAY EYEWEAR

The combination of lightweight construction, strength, flexibility, and ergonomic design makes ULTEM an excellent material choice for modern eyewear.

It supports the comfort and durability required for a wide range of everyday activities.

PRODUCED WITH NANO TECHNOLOGY

ADVANCED FUNCTIONAL FRAME & LENS TECHNOLOGY

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES is developed using a nano technology concept, integrating 12 functional materials and components into the frame and temples, complemented by 9 advanced lens protection features.

Nano technology enables the incorporation of extremely small-scale materials into selected formulations to support the physical and functional characteristics of the product.

This integrated approach is designed to deliver eyewear that combines premium aesthetics with wearing comfort, material quality, and appropriate optical protection for everyday activities.

12 ADVANCED FUNCTIONAL MATERIALS

12 FUNCTIONAL MATERIALS AND COMPONENTS IN THE FRAME & TEMPLES

1. BLACK TOURMALINE

Black Tourmaline is a natural mineral known for its distinctive electrical and thermal characteristics. Within MGISPEC technology, it forms part of the functional material concept associated with negative ions and Far-Infrared (FIR) technology.

Benefit: Supports material innovation focused on wearing comfort. Its direct effects on eye health require specific clinical evidence.

2. NEGATIVE IONS

Negative ions are electrically charged particles naturally found in the environment. The negative ion concept is incorporated into MGISPEC's functional material development.

Potential benefit: Negative ions have been studied in relation to environmental conditions and certain physiological responses. However, the ability of ions released from eyewear frames to reduce eye fatigue or oxidative stress has not been established without appropriate product-specific testing.

  1. FAR-INFRARED (FIR)

Far-Infrared is part of the infrared radiation spectrum. The 4–14 micrometer wavelength range is commonly discussed in the development of functional FIR materials.

Potential benefit: FIR technology has been studied in various applications involving thermal responses and circulation. Direct benefits to ocular microcirculation, the retina, or ciliary muscles from wearing MGISPEC frames require specific clinical evidence.

4. ORGANIC GERMANIUM

Germanium is an element recognized for its semiconductor characteristics. Germanium components may be incorporated as part of an integrated functional material system.

Benefit: Supports MGISPEC's material innovation concept. Its presence in an eyewear frame does not independently establish therapeutic benefits for the eyes.

5. NANO SILVER

Nano Silver consists of nanoscale silver particles recognized in material science for antimicrobial characteristics under certain formulations and conditions.

Benefit: May support the development of more hygienic material surfaces when antimicrobial performance has been verified through product testing.

6. GRAPHENE

Graphene is an extremely thin carbon-based material known for its remarkable mechanical strength and thermal conductivity.

Benefit: When appropriately formulated, graphene may contribute to strength, stability, and heat distribution within composite frame materials.

7. BAMBOO CHARCOAL

Bamboo Charcoal is a porous carbon-based material produced through the carbonization of bamboo.

Benefit: Possesses certain adsorption characteristics and may be used as an additional component in functional material formulations.

8. FUNCTIONAL MINERAL BLEND

A specially formulated combination of minerals designed to function as part of MGISPEC's integrated material system.

Benefit: Supports the development of physical and functional material characteristics through a carefully formulated mineral combination.

  1. ZINC OXIDE (ZnO)

Zinc Oxide is a mineral compound widely used in material technology, including ultraviolet protection applications in certain formulations.

Benefit: May contribute to UV-related protective characteristics and material stability, depending on concentration and formulation.

  1. TITANIUM DIOXIDE (TiO₂)

Titanium Dioxide is a mineral material known for its optical characteristics, stability, and interaction with ultraviolet radiation.

Benefit: May support optical properties, durability, and protective material characteristics in suitable formulations.

  1. ZIRCONIUM DIOXIDE (ZrO₂)

Zirconium Dioxide is an advanced ceramic material recognized for its hardness, wear resistance, and thermal stability.

Benefit: May contribute to the mechanical strength and long-term durability of composite materials.

  1. NANO SILICON DIOXIDE (SiO₂)

Nano Silicon Dioxide consists of nanoscale silica particles used in various material applications to enhance surface and structural characteristics.

Benefit: May improve hardness, stability, and scratch resistance in selected material formulations.

9 ADVANCED LENS PROTECTION FEATURES

9 LENS PROTECTION FEATURES FOR EVERYDAY ACTIVITIES

1. BLUE LIGHT FILTERING

Designed to filter a portion of blue light within selected wavelength ranges.

Benefit: Helps reduce the amount of blue light transmitted through the lenses. The filtering percentage and any associated visual comfort benefits require appropriate optical testing and evaluation.

  1. UVA & UVB PROTECTION (UV400)

Designed to provide ultraviolet protection against UVA and UVB radiation up to a wavelength of 400 nm.

Benefit: Helps reduce UV exposure to the eyes. Adequate ultraviolet protection is an important part of maintaining long-term eye health.

3. SCRATCH-RESISTANT SURFACE

The lens surface is designed to improve resistance to minor scratches associated with everyday use.

Benefit: Helps maintain optical clarity and long-term visual comfort.

4. SHATTER-RESISTANT CONSTRUCTION

The lens construction is designed to reduce the likelihood of breaking into sharp fragments under certain impacts or pressures.

Benefit: Helps improve user safety compared with more fragile lens materials, subject to verified product resistance testing.

5. HIGH IMPACT RESISTANCE

The lens material is designed to withstand impacts encountered during normal activities.

Benefit: Provides additional mechanical protection. However, these glasses are not a substitute for certified industrial safety eyewear.

6. OIL-REPELLENT SURFACE

The lens surface is designed to reduce the adhesion of oils, fingerprints, and certain contaminants.

Benefit: Helps simplify cleaning and maintain clear vision.

7. ELECTROMAGNETIC RADIATION (EMF) FEATURE

The lens material technology is developed around the concept of managing interactions with light and electromagnetic radiation within selected ranges.

Benefit: Any relevant filtering performance must be verified through specific testing. This feature should not be interpreted as comprehensive protection against all forms of electromagnetic radiation.

8. ANTI-STATIC PERFORMANCE

The lens surface technology is designed to help reduce the accumulation of static electrical charges.

Benefit: May reduce the tendency of dust to adhere to the lens surface, supporting cleanliness and visual comfort.

9. CORROSION RESISTANCE

The lens material and surface are designed to resist certain environmental conditions that may affect surface quality.

Benefit: Helps maintain material stability, surface quality, and lens durability with appropriate use and care.

COLORS

MGISPEC UT157 – RED

A bold combination of a black frame and red accents delivers an energetic, fashionable, and distinctive character. The red detailing adds visual personality while preserving an elegant overall appearance.

EYEWEAR SIZE

The 49–17–146 mm dimensions are designed to balance frame proportions, wearing stability, and comfort.

Actual fit depends on individual facial features and frame adjustment.

MGISPEC — INNOVATION FOR MODERN LIFESTYLES

In today's digital lifestyle, choosing comfortable eyewear with appropriate optical protection is an important part of maintaining healthy eye-care habits.

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES combines premium design, advanced ULTEM material technology also used in the aerospace industry, nano technology, and functional lens protection features to support everyday visual needs.

MGISPEC CLINICAL TRIAL RESULTS

MGISPEC functional eyewear technology was evaluated in a prospective, randomized, parallel-controlled clinical trial at Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. The study involved 150 participants divided into three groups, with eyewear worn for at least 8 hours per day for 15 consecutive days.

After 15 days, the MGISPEC group recorded a visual-fatigue score of 12.23 ± 1.34, compared with 17.87 ± 2.11 in the ordinary optical-eyewear group and 15.15 ± 1.77 in the conventional blue-light-filtering group (P=0.002). The overall effectiveness rate for visual-acuity improvement reached 90%, while the overall relief rate for dry-eye symptoms reached 92%. No serious adverse events were reported.

Important: the clinical trial evaluated the MGISPEC eyewear Note: MGISPEC eyewear does not replace professional eye examinations, diagnosis, or medical treatment. Specific protective specifications and health-related benefits must be supported by relevant product testing.

HOW TO USE MGISPEC

Good vision plays an important role in supporting daily activities and overall quality of life. To promote comfortable use and help maintain eye health, please follow these guidelines:

  1. Wear MGISPEC regularly for at least 8–10 hours per day, particularly during your daily activities.
  2. If you have a high degree of myopia (nearsightedness), hyperopia (farsightedness), or astigmatism, it is recommended that you consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional. MGISPEC lenses can be replaced with prescription lenses tailored to your individual vision needs by a qualified optical professional or based on the recommendation of an ophthalmologist.
  3. If you experience eye discomfort, eye-related symptoms, or changes in your vision, do not rely solely on wearing eyeglasses. You are advised to consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional for appropriate examination, evaluation, and treatment.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

MGISPEC products are not a substitute for professional medical examination, diagnosis, medication, or treatment. If you experience eye discomfort, vision problems, or have an existing eye condition, please consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional.

HOW TO CARE FOR YOUR MGISPEC

To help maintain the cleanliness, comfort, and overall condition of your MGISPEC eyewear, please follow these care instructions:

  1. Fold the temples before placing down or storing your eyewear. Avoid placing the glasses with the front surface of the lenses directly against a table or any other surface to help prevent scratches.
  2. Clean the lenses with clean water or a lens-cleaning solution specifically designed for eyeglasses. If oil, dust, perspiration, or other residue is difficult to remove, gently wipe the lenses with a clean, soft microfiber cloth.
  3. Store your eyewear in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Under normal storage conditions, keep the product at a temperature between 0°C and 45°C.
  4. Avoid prolonged exposure to extreme temperatures. Do not leave the product at temperatures below –10°C or above 45°C for extended periods, as extreme temperatures may cause deformation or changes in the shape of certain parts of the eyewear.
  5. Use mild soap when necessary and clean the lenses with a soft microfiber cloth. Do not use tissues, paper towels, or other rough materials, as they may scratch the lens surface.
  6. Avoid household cleaning products and alcohol. Clean your eyewear regularly to help prevent the accumulation of dust, oil, perspiration, and other residue.
MGI-UT157-RED.cn:
MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 系列

Beyond Vision. Beyond Protection.

LIGHTWEIGHT. FLEXIBLE. STRONG. ELEGANT.

先进材料科技，打造全天候舒适佩戴体验

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 系列融合了高性能 ULTEM 材料、纳米科技、人体工学设计，以及先进功能性镜框与镜片技术（Advanced Functional Frame & Lens Technology），在舒适性、耐用性、眼部防护与优雅外观之间实现理想平衡。

本系列采用现代而精致的圆形镜框设计（Round Frame），适合办公、学习、使用电子设备、旅行及日常生活等多种场景。

凭借轻盈、柔韧、坚固且舒适的结构设计，MGISPEC UT157 成为注重品质、科技与专业形象人士的理想选择。

什么是 ULTEM 材料？

同样应用于航空航天工业的先进高性能材料科技

ULTEM（聚醚酰亚胺，Polyetherimide/PEI）是一种高性能工程热塑性塑料，以其轻量化结构、优异的机械强度、良好的尺寸稳定性、灵活的设计适应性以及出色的耐高温性能而著称。

凭借这些卓越特性，ULTEM 成为多个高科技工业领域的重要工程材料之一，其中包括航空及航空航天工业（Aerospace Industry）。

在航空航天领域，ULTEM 被应用于特定零部件，包括飞机内饰部件、电气组件，以及其他对材料轻量化、机械强度、稳定性和安全标准具有严格要求的工程应用。

ULTEM 在航空工业中的应用，充分体现了这种先进材料的工程技术价值，尤其适用于高度重视重量效率、机械耐用性及材料性能的应用领域。

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 系列将这种高性能材料科技的优势融入现代眼镜设计之中，结合轻盈结构、良好柔韧性、坚固耐用的特性，以及全天候舒适佩戴体验。

源自航空航天领域的先进材料科技，如今融入 MGISPEC 高端眼镜设计。

ULTEM 材料的六大核心优势

1. EXTREMELY LIGHTWEIGHT — 极致轻盈

ULTEM 材料能够在保持结构强度的同时，实现轻量化镜框设计。

轻盈的重量有助于减轻鼻梁与耳部承受的压力，提升长时间佩戴时的舒适度。

2. STRONG & DURABLE — 坚固耐用

ULTEM 具有良好的机械强度和耐用性，适合日常使用。

其材料特性有助于保持镜框结构稳定，并在正确使用与保养的情况下延长产品的使用寿命。

3. EXCELLENT FLEXIBILITY — 优良柔韧性

ULTEM 材料可用于设计具有良好柔韧性的镜框结构，以提升日常佩戴舒适度。

经过合理设计的柔韧结构，有助于降低正常使用过程中因轻微压力造成损坏的风险。

4. HEAT & STEAM RESISTANT — 耐高温与耐蒸汽

ULTEM 是一种具有优异耐热性能的工程材料。

根据材料等级、暴露时间及测试条件，某些 ULTEM 材料可用于需要承受约 170°C 温度的特定应用环境。

这种特性有助于维持镜框材料在正常温度变化下的稳定性，但仍应避免将眼镜直接暴露于极端高温环境。

5. SKIN-FRIENDLY COMFORT — 亲肤舒适

经过适当加工的 ULTEM 材料，可以形成光滑且舒适的镜框表面。

轻量化设计有助于减少长时间佩戴时鼻梁与耳部所承受的压力。对于敏感肌肤的适用性，仍取决于具体产品配方及个人情况。

6. IDEAL FOR EVERYDAY EYEWEAR — 适合日常佩戴

ULTEM 结合轻量化结构、机械强度、柔韧性及人体工学设计，是制造现代眼镜的优质材料选择。

其特性能够满足多种日常活动对舒适性与耐用性的需求。

采用纳米科技制造

ADVANCED FUNCTIONAL FRAME & LENS TECHNOLOGY

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 系列采用纳米科技理念，将 12 种功能性材料及成分融入镜框与镜腿，并结合 9 项先进镜片防护功能。

纳米科技能够在特定材料配方中应用极微小尺度的材料成分，以支持产品的物理性能及功能特性。

这种整合式技术理念不仅注重眼镜的高端时尚外观，也重视日常佩戴舒适度、材料品质及适当的光学防护性能。

12 ADVANCED FUNCTIONAL MATERIALS

镜框与镜腿中的 12 种先进功能性材料及成分

1. BLACK TOURMALINE — 黑碧玺

黑碧玺是一种天然矿物，具有独特的电学及热学特性。在 MGISPEC 技术体系中，黑碧玺是与负离子及远红外线（FIR）技术理念相关的功能性材料之一。

潜在价值： 支持以佩戴舒适性为导向的材料创新。其对眼部健康的直接影响仍需要专门的临床证据支持。

2. NEGATIVE IONS — 负离子

负离子是自然环境中存在的带负电荷粒子。MGISPEC 将负离子概念应用于功能性材料的研发之中。

潜在益处： 负离子已被用于研究环境条件及某些生理反应。然而，眼镜框释放的负离子能否缓解视疲劳或降低氧化应激，仍需通过适当的产品专项测试加以证实。

3. FAR-INFRARED (FIR) — 远红外线

远红外线属于红外辐射光谱的一部分。4–14 微米的波长范围经常被用于功能性远红外材料的研发与讨论。

潜在益处： 远红外技术已在热效应及循环相关领域受到研究。但佩戴 MGISPEC 镜框是否能够直接改善眼部微循环、视网膜或睫状肌功能，仍需要专门的临床证据支持。

4. ORGANIC GERMANIUM — 有机锗

锗是一种具有半导体特性的元素。锗相关成分可作为综合功能性材料系统的一部分。

作用： 支持 MGISPEC 的材料创新理念。但镜框中含有该成分，并不代表其已被证实具有直接的眼部治疗功效。

5. NANO SILVER — 纳米银

纳米银是由纳米尺度银颗粒组成的材料。在特定配方及条件下，纳米银因其抗微生物特性而受到材料科学领域的关注。

潜在益处： 如果产品通过相关抗菌性能测试，纳米银可用于支持更卫生的材料表面设计。

6. GRAPHENE — 石墨烯

石墨烯是一种极薄的碳基材料，以优异的机械强度和导热性能而闻名。

作用： 在适当的材料配方中，石墨烯可帮助提升复合镜框材料的强度、稳定性及热量分布性能。

7. BAMBOO CHARCOAL — 竹炭

竹炭是通过竹材炭化工艺制成的多孔碳材料。

作用： 具有一定的吸附特性，可作为功能性材料配方中的辅助成分。

8. FUNCTIONAL MINERAL BLEND — 功能性矿物复合配方

由多种矿物成分经过专门配比组成，作为 MGISPEC 综合材料系统的一部分。

作用： 通过专门的配方组合，支持材料物理性能及功能特性的开发。

9. ZINC OXIDE (ZnO) — 氧化锌

氧化锌是一种广泛应用于材料科技的矿物化合物，在特定配方中也可用于紫外线防护相关应用。

作用： 根据实际浓度与配方，可帮助改善材料的紫外线相关防护特性及稳定性。

10. TITANIUM DIOXIDE (TiO₂) — 二氧化钛

二氧化钛是一种具有特殊光学特性、良好稳定性，并能够与紫外辐射发生相互作用的矿物材料。

作用： 在适当配方中，可支持材料的光学性能、耐用性及相关防护特性。

11. ZIRCONIUM DIOXIDE (ZrO₂) — 二氧化锆

二氧化锆是一种先进工程陶瓷材料，以高硬度、良好的耐磨性及热稳定性而著称。

作用： 可帮助提升复合材料的机械强度与长期耐用性。

12. NANO SILICON DIOXIDE (SiO₂) — 纳米二氧化硅

纳米二氧化硅是由纳米尺度二氧化硅颗粒组成的材料，广泛应用于改善材料表面及结构性能的技术领域。

作用： 在特定材料配方中，可帮助提高硬度、稳定性及抗刮擦性能。

9 ADVANCED LENS PROTECTION FEATURES

九项先进镜片防护功能，满足日常用眼需求

MGISPEC 临床试验结果

MGISPEC 功能眼镜科技已在天津华厦眼科医院进行前瞻性、随机、平行对照临床试验。研究共纳入 150 名受试者，分为三组，每天佩戴至少 8 小时，连续 15 天。

15 天后，MGISPEC 组视觉疲劳评分为 12.23 ± 1.34；普通光学眼镜组为 17.87 ± 2.11；传统蓝光过滤眼镜组为 15.15 ± 1.77（P=0.002）。视力改善总体有效率达到 90%，干眼症状总体缓解率达到 92%，且未报告严重不良事件。

重要说明：临床试验评估的是 MGISPEC 负离子、远红外与蓝光过滤功能眼镜的整体技术系统，而不是证明每一种材料单独具有医疗治疗效果。上述材料功能说明主要体现材料特性及临床报告中讨论的潜在作用机制。

为了帮助保持 MGISPEC 眼镜的清洁、舒适度及良好状态，请遵循以下保养方法：

APA ITU MATERIAL ULTEM?

TEKNOLOGI MATERIAL CANGGIH YANG JUGA DIGUNAKAN DALAM INDUSTRI PENERBANGAN

ULTEM (Polyetherimide/PEI) merupakan material termoplastik rekayasa berkinerja tinggi yang dikenal memiliki kombinasi luar biasa antara bobot ringan, kekuatan mekanis, kestabilan dimensi, fleksibilitas desain, serta ketahanan terhadap suhu tinggi.

Keunggulan tersebut menjadikan ULTEM salah satu material teknik penting yang digunakan dalam berbagai industri berteknologi tinggi, termasuk industri penerbangan dan dirgantara (Aerospace Industry).

Dalam industri penerbangan, ULTEM digunakan pada komponen tertentu, seperti bagian interior pesawat, komponen kelistrikan, serta aplikasi teknik khusus yang membutuhkan material ringan, kuat, stabil, dan memenuhi persyaratan keselamatan yang ketat.

Penggunaan ULTEM dalam industri penerbangan menunjukkan nilai teknologi material ini, terutama dalam aplikasi yang mengutamakan efisiensi bobot, ketahanan mekanis, dan performa material.

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES membawa keunggulan material berteknologi tinggi tersebut ke dalam desain kacamata modern, menghadirkan bingkai yang ringan, fleksibel, tahan lama, dan nyaman digunakan sepanjang hari.

  1. INFRA MERAH JAUH (FAR-INFRARED / FIR)

Infra merah Jauh (FIR) mempunyai rentang panjang gelombang yang aman yaitu 4–14 µm (micrometer).

Mikrometer merupakan satuan ukuran panjang yang sangat kecil.

  • 1 mikrometer (µm) = 0,001 milimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4.000 nanometer (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14.000 nanometer (nm).

Jadi, 4–14 µm berarti panjang gelombang inframerah antara 4.000 hingga 14.000 nanometer.

Manfaat: Membantu mengurangi paparan radiasi UV pada mata. Perlindungan UV yang memadai merupakan bagian penting dalam menjaga kesehatan mata jangka panjang.

3. SCRATCH-RESISTANT SURFACE — PERMUKAAN TAHAN GORES

Permukaan lensa dirancang untuk meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap goresan ringan akibat penggunaan sehari-hari.

Manfaat: Membantu menjaga kejernihan optik lensa dan kenyamanan penglihatan dalam jangka panjang.

4. SHATTER-RESISTANT CONSTRUCTION — KONSTRUKSI TAHAN PECAH

Konstruksi lensa dirancang untuk mengurangi risiko pecah menjadi serpihan tajam ketika menerima tekanan atau benturan tertentu.

Manfaat: Membantu meningkatkan keamanan penggunaan dibandingkan material lensa yang lebih mudah pecah, sesuai hasil pengujian ketahanan produk.

5. HIGH IMPACT RESISTANCE — KETAHANAN BENTURAN TINGGI

Material lensa dirancang memiliki ketahanan terhadap benturan dalam aktivitas normal.

Manfaat: Memberikan perlindungan mekanis tambahan bagi pengguna. Namun, kacamata ini bukan pengganti kacamata keselamatan industri yang tersertifikasi.

6. OIL-REPELLENT SURFACE — PERMUKAAN PENOLAK MINYAK

Permukaan lensa dirancang untuk mengurangi daya lekat minyak, sidik jari, dan kotoran tertentu.

Manfaat: Membantu mempermudah pembersihan dan mempertahankan kejernihan penglihatan.

7. ELECTROMAGNETIC RADIATION (EMF) — FITUR TERKAIT RADIASI ELEKTROMAGNETIK

Teknologi material lensa dikembangkan dengan konsep pengelolaan interaksi terhadap cahaya dan radiasi elektromagnetik pada rentang tertentu.

Manfaat: Karakteristik penyaringan pada rentang yang relevan harus dibuktikan melalui pengujian khusus. Fitur ini tidak berarti perlindungan menyeluruh terhadap seluruh jenis radiasi elektromagnetik.

8. ANTI-STATIC PERFORMANCE — PERLINDUNGAN ANTISTATIS

Teknologi permukaan lensa dirancang untuk membantu mengurangi akumulasi muatan listrik statis.

Manfaat: Berpotensi mengurangi kecenderungan debu menempel pada permukaan lensa sehingga membantu menjaga kebersihan dan kenyamanan penglihatan.

9. CORROSION RESISTANCE — KETAHANAN TERHADAP KOROSI

Material dan permukaan lensa dirancang memiliki ketahanan terhadap kondisi lingkungan tertentu yang dapat memengaruhi kualitas permukaan.

Manfaat: Membantu menjaga kestabilan material, kualitas permukaan, dan daya tahan lensa selama penggunaan serta perawatan yang sesuai.

HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

  1. Gunakan MGISPEC secara rutin selama minimal 8–10 jam per hari, terutama saat menjalani aktivitas sehari-hari.
  2. Apabila Anda memiliki kelainan refraksi dengan ukuran minus, plus, atau silinder yang tinggi, disarankan untuk berkonsultasi dengan dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata. Lensa MGISPEC dapat diganti dengan lensa resep yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan penglihatan Anda melalui optik profesional atau berdasarkan rekomendasi dokter mata.
  3. Apabila Anda mengalami keluhan pada mata atau perubahan pada penglihatan, jangan hanya mengandalkan penggunaan kacamata. Tetap disarankan untuk memeriksakan kondisi mata kepada dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata guna mendapatkan pemeriksaan dan penanganan yang sesuai.

PERHATIAN

CARA MERAWAT MGISPEC

Untuk membantu menjaga kebersihan, kenyamanan, dan kondisi kacamata MGISPEC agar tetap optimal, ikuti petunjuk perawatan berikut:

  1. Lipat tangkai kacamata sebelum meletakkan atau menyimpannya. Hindari meletakkan kacamata dengan permukaan depan lensa menghadap langsung ke meja atau permukaan lainnya untuk membantu mencegah goresan.
  2. Bersihkan lensa menggunakan air bersih atau cairan pembersih khusus lensa kacamata. Apabila terdapat minyak, debu, keringat, atau kotoran yang sulit dibersihkan, usap lensa secara perlahan menggunakan kain mikrofiber yang bersih dan lembut.
  3. Simpan kacamata di tempat yang sejuk dan kering, serta terlindung dari paparan sinar matahari langsung. Untuk penyimpanan normal, simpan pada suhu antara 0°C hingga 45°C.
  4. Hindari paparan suhu ekstrem dalam waktu lama. Jangan membiarkan produk berada pada suhu di bawah –10°C atau di atas 45°C dalam waktu yang berkepanjangan karena dapat menyebabkan perubahan bentuk atau deformasi pada bagian tertentu dari kacamata.
  5. Gunakan sabun yang lembut. Gunakan kain microfiber. (Jangan gunakan tisu atau bahan kain lain yang kasar.),
  6. Hindari penggunaan pembersih rumah tangga dan alkohol, Bersihkan kacamata secara rutin.
MGI-UT157-TEA.en:
MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES

Beyond Vision. Beyond Protection.

LIGHTWEIGHT. FLEXIBLE. STRONG. ELEGANT.

ADVANCED MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY FOR ALL-DAY COMFORT

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES introduces premium eyewear innovation combining high-performance ULTEM material, nano technology, ergonomic design, and Advanced Functional Frame & Lens Technology to create an exceptional balance of comfort, durability, eye protection, and elegant style.

Featuring a modern and sophisticated round-frame design, MGISPEC UT157 is developed to complement various activities, including working, studying, using digital devices, traveling, and everyday routines.

With its lightweight, flexible, strong, and comfortable construction, MGISPEC UT157 is an ideal choice for individuals who value quality, technology, and professional appearance.

WHAT IS ULTEM MATERIAL?

ADVANCED HIGH-PERFORMANCE MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY ALSO USED IN THE AEROSPACE INDUSTRY

ULTEM (Polyetherimide/PEI) is a high-performance engineering thermoplastic recognized for its exceptional combination of lightweight construction, mechanical strength, dimensional stability, design flexibility, and high-temperature resistance.

These outstanding properties make ULTEM an important engineering material used across various high-technology industries, including the aviation and aerospace industry.

In aerospace applications, ULTEM is used in selected components, including aircraft interior parts, electrical components, and specialized engineering applications requiring lightweight, strong, stable materials that meet stringent safety requirements.

Its use in the aerospace industry demonstrates the advanced engineering value of this material, particularly in applications where weight efficiency, mechanical durability, and material performance are essential.

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES brings the advantages of this high-performance material technology into modern eyewear, combining lightweight construction, flexibility, durability, and exceptional everyday wearing comfort.

FROM AEROSPACE MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY TO PREMIUM MGISPEC EYEWEAR.

6 KEY ADVANTAGES OF ULTEM MATERIAL

1. EXTREMELY LIGHTWEIGHT

ULTEM enables the production of lightweight eyewear frames without compromising structural strength.

Its reduced weight helps minimize pressure on the nose and ears, enhancing comfort during extended wear.

2. STRONG & DURABLE

ULTEM provides excellent mechanical strength and durability for everyday use.

These characteristics help maintain frame stability and contribute to long-lasting product performance with appropriate use and care.

3. EXCELLENT FLEXIBILITY

ULTEM allows eyewear frames to be engineered with flexibility that supports everyday wearing comfort.

Properly designed flexibility helps reduce the risk of damage from minor stresses during normal activities.

4. HEAT & STEAM RESISTANT

ULTEM is an engineering material recognized for its high thermal resistance.

Certain ULTEM grades can be used in applications requiring resistance to temperatures of approximately 170°C, depending on the material grade, exposure duration, and testing conditions.

This characteristic helps maintain frame stability under normal temperature variations. However, eyewear should still be protected from direct exposure to extreme heat.

5. SKIN-FRIENDLY COMFORT

When properly processed, ULTEM can provide a smooth frame surface that feels comfortable against the skin.

Its lightweight design helps reduce pressure around the nose and ears during extended wear. Suitability for sensitive skin depends on the specific product formulation and individual conditions.

6. IDEAL FOR EVERYDAY EYEWEAR

The combination of lightweight construction, strength, flexibility, and ergonomic design makes ULTEM an excellent material choice for modern eyewear.

It supports the comfort and durability required for a wide range of everyday activities.

PRODUCED WITH NANO TECHNOLOGY

ADVANCED FUNCTIONAL FRAME & LENS TECHNOLOGY

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES is developed using a nano technology concept, integrating 12 functional materials and components into the frame and temples, complemented by 9 advanced lens protection features.

Nano technology enables the incorporation of extremely small-scale materials into selected formulations to support the physical and functional characteristics of the product.

This integrated approach is designed to deliver eyewear that combines premium aesthetics with wearing comfort, material quality, and appropriate optical protection for everyday activities.

12 FUNCTIONAL MATERIALS AND COMPONENTS IN THE FRAME & TEMPLES

1. BLACK TOURMALINE

Black Tourmaline is a natural mineral known for its unique properties in naturally generating Negative Ions and emitting Far-Infrared (FIR) radiation.

Two Main Functions of Black Tourmaline:

  • Negative Ion Generation: Helps create a fresher and more comfortable environment.
  • Far-Infrared (FIR) Emission: Naturally emits far-infrared energy within the safe wavelength range of 4–14 micrometers (µm).

Potential Benefits in Everyday Applications:

  • Supports eye comfort.
  • Helps support microcirculation.
  • Provides a relaxing effect.
  • Supports comfort during prolonged wear.

In MGISPEC, finely powdered Black Tourmaline is precisely integrated into the frame material to optimize its Negative Ion and FIR functions.

2. NEGATIVE IONS

Negative Ions are often referred to as "Vitamins in the Air" and play an important role in supporting eye comfort and reducing the risk of eye fatigue.

Functions of Negative Ions in MGISPEC:

  • Help reduce eye fatigue caused by prolonged use.
  • Designed to support eye comfort during daily activities, particularly when using digital devices.
  • Help provide a more relaxed and comfortable sensation around the eyes while wearing the glasses.
  • Support comfort around the eye and temple areas.

In the MGISPEC clinical report, Negative Ions are discussed as one of the potential mechanisms associated with free-radical neutralization, reduction of oxidative stress, and autonomic regulation, which may contribute to ocular muscle relaxation and eye comfort.

  1. FAR-INFRARED (FIR)

Far-Infrared (FIR) has a safe wavelength range of 4–14 µm (micrometers).

A micrometer is a unit used to measure extremely small lengths.

  • 1 micrometer (µm) = 0.001 millimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4,000 nanometers (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14,000 nanometers (nm).

Therefore, 4–14 µm refers to infrared wavelengths ranging from 4,000 to 14,000 nanometers.

FIR 4–14 µm (4,000–14,000 nm)

Benefits of Far-Infrared (FIR) in MGISPEC:

  • Helps improve blood circulation in areas subjected to pressure.
  • Helps relieve muscle fatigue around the eyes.
  • Helps facilitate moisture absorption and release to reduce feelings of heat and stickiness.
  • Provides supplementary antibacterial and deodorizing effects.
  • Helps neutralize static electricity.

Furthermore, FIR within the 4–14 µm wavelength range is discussed in the MGISPEC clinical report as a potential mechanism that may support capillary dilation and blood supply to the ciliary muscles, retina, and choroid, thereby potentially supporting ocular microcirculation, comfort, and visual function.

4. NANO SILVER

A material technology with strong, broad-spectrum antibacterial, antiviral, and antifungal capabilities.

Silver is recognized in materials science for its antimicrobial characteristics in certain applications and formulations. In MGISPEC, Nano Silver is incorporated as part of the nanomaterial technology used in the frame and temple system.

  1. GERMANIUM (Ge)

A functional material technology with semiconductor characteristics, integrated with other minerals as part of MGISPEC's comprehensive material system.

  • Helps regulate the body's micro-bioelectrical currents to relieve nervous tension.
  • Helps enhance Far-Infrared (FIR) resonance to support local microcirculation.
  • Helps generate mild Negative Ions to neutralize electromagnetic static electricity.
  • Helps support antibacterial comfort and reduce the risk of skin allergies.
  • Helps maintain temperature stability and reduce moisture caused by perspiration.
  • Helps provide beneficial antioxidant functions.

6. GRAPHENE

An advanced carbon-based functional material technology that is strong and lightweight, with excellent physical and thermal properties.

  • Helps dissipate heat very rapidly to reduce feelings of heat and stickiness (Key Advantage).
  • Supports Far-Infrared (FIR) functions to reduce pressure marks and discomfort around the eyes.
  • Provides mild antistatic and Negative Ion effects to reduce dust accumulation.
  • Helps comprehensively enhance the durability of eyeglass frames (Additional Advantage).

7. BAMBOO CHARCOAL

A carbon-based material technology with a porous structure, used as part of MGISPEC's functional material formulation.

  • Helps absorb odors, oil, and perspiration (Main Advantage).
  • Helps regulate moisture for a dry, non-sticky, and comfortable wearing experience.
  • Provides mild Far-Infrared (FIR) emission to support local blood circulation.
  • Provides a physical antibacterial effect as a supplementary function.

8. FUNCTIONAL MINERAL BLEND

A combination of selected minerals designed to work as part of an integrated material system. It supports the functions of each component contained in MGISPEC.

  1. ZINC OXIDE (ZnO)

A material widely used in material technology due to its stability and functional characteristics, and incorporated as part of MGISPEC's nanomaterial formulation.

  • Helps provide a long-lasting, broad-spectrum antibacterial effect.
  • Helps provide broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection to slow down frame aging and discoloration.
  • Supports mild thermal conductivity and heat dissipation to reduce feelings of heat and stickiness.
  • Helps reinforce the frame material to improve resistance to wear and deformation.
  1. TITANIUM DIOXIDE (TiO₂)

A stable material commonly used in various material technology applications and integrated as one of the components of MGISPEC's functional system.

  • Helps provide strong UV protection to prevent frame yellowing (Main Advantage of the Rutile Type).
  • Provides photocatalytic self-cleaning technology and passive antibacterial effects (Advantage of the Anatase Type).
  • Provides high opacity to enhance the appearance of eyeglass frames.
  • Features low surface energy, oil resistance, and easy cleaning.
  • Offers high chemical stability and a low risk of allergic reactions.
  1. ZIRCONIUM DIOXIDE (ZrO₂)

A ceramic material known for its stability and excellent mechanical characteristics, supporting the formulation of frame materials designed for everyday use.

  • Provides very high resistance to wear, scratches, and whitish discoloration.
  • Is bio-inert and skin-friendly, with a low risk of allergic reactions (Main Advantage).
  • Helps maintain dimensional stability against expansion and contraction caused by temperature changes.
  • Helps emit moderate-intensity Far-Infrared (FIR) radiation within the 4–14 µm wavelength range.
  • Provides a smooth, dirt-resistant surface for easier cleaning.
  1. NANO SILICA (SiO₂)

A nanomaterial used to support the physical characteristics and overall stability of the material system.

  • Helps increase frame hardness and resistance to scratches and wear.
  • Helps improve dimensional stability and resistance to deformation.
  • Helps reduce surface stickiness, repel oil, and facilitate cleaning.
  • Helps create a smooth matte texture and improve wearing comfort.
  • Helps improve resistance to UV-induced aging and prevent frame yellowing. 9 ADVANCED LENS PROTECTION FEATURES

9 LENS PROTECTION FEATURES FOR EVERYDAY ACTIVITIES

1. BLUE LIGHT FILTERING

Designed to filter a portion of blue light within selected wavelength ranges.

Benefit: Helps reduce the amount of blue light transmitted through the lenses. The filtering percentage and any associated visual comfort benefits require appropriate optical testing and evaluation.

  1. UVA & UVB PROTECTION (UV400)

Designed to provide ultraviolet protection against UVA and UVB radiation up to a wavelength of 400 nm.

Benefit: Helps reduce UV exposure to the eyes. Adequate ultraviolet protection is an important part of maintaining long-term eye health.

3. SCRATCH-RESISTANT SURFACE

The lens surface is designed to improve resistance to minor scratches associated with everyday use.

Benefit: Helps maintain optical clarity and long-term visual comfort.

4. SHATTER-RESISTANT CONSTRUCTION

The lens construction is designed to reduce the likelihood of breaking into sharp fragments under certain impacts or pressures.

Benefit: Helps improve user safety compared with more fragile lens materials, subject to verified product resistance testing.

5. HIGH IMPACT RESISTANCE

The lens material is designed to withstand impacts encountered during normal activities.

Benefit: Provides additional mechanical protection. However, these glasses are not a substitute for certified industrial safety eyewear.

6. OIL-REPELLENT SURFACE

The lens surface is designed to reduce the adhesion of oils, fingerprints, and certain contaminants.

Benefit: Helps simplify cleaning and maintain clear vision.

7. ELECTROMAGNETIC RADIATION (EMF) FEATURE

The lens material technology is developed around the concept of managing interactions with light and electromagnetic radiation within selected ranges.

Benefit: Any relevant filtering performance must be verified through specific testing. This feature should not be interpreted as comprehensive protection against all forms of electromagnetic radiation.

8. ANTI-STATIC PERFORMANCE

The lens surface technology is designed to help reduce the accumulation of static electrical charges.

Benefit: May reduce the tendency of dust to adhere to the lens surface, supporting cleanliness and visual comfort.

9. CORROSION RESISTANCE

The lens material and surface are designed to resist certain environmental conditions that may affect surface quality.

Benefit: Helps maintain material stability, surface quality, and lens durability with appropriate use and care.

COLORS

MGISPEC UT157 – TEA

A dark-toned frame complemented by tea-brown accents creates a warm, natural, and sophisticated appearance. Ideal for individuals who appreciate timeless styling with a premium contemporary touch.

EYEWEAR SIZE

The 49–17–146 mm dimensions are designed to balance frame proportions, wearing stability, and comfort.

Actual fit depends on individual facial features and frame adjustment.

MGISPEC — INNOVATION FOR MODERN LIFESTYLES

In today's digital lifestyle, choosing comfortable eyewear with appropriate optical protection is an important part of maintaining healthy eye-care habits.

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 SERIES combines premium design, advanced ULTEM material technology also used in the aerospace industry, nano technology, and functional lens protection features to support everyday visual needs.

MGISPEC CLINICAL TRIAL RESULTS

MGISPEC functional eyewear technology was evaluated in a prospective, randomized, parallel-controlled clinical trial at Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. The study involved 150 participants divided into three groups, with eyewear worn for at least 8 hours per day for 15 consecutive days.

After 15 days, the MGISPEC group recorded a visual-fatigue score of 12.23 ± 1.34, compared with 17.87 ± 2.11 in the ordinary optical-eyewear group and 15.15 ± 1.77 in the conventional blue-light-filtering group (P=0.002). The overall effectiveness rate for visual-acuity improvement reached 90%, while the overall relief rate for dry-eye symptoms reached 92%. No serious adverse events were reported.

Important: the clinical trial evaluated the MGISPEC eyewear Note: MGISPEC eyewear does not replace professional eye examinations, diagnosis, or medical treatment. Specific protective specifications and health-related benefits must be supported by relevant product testing.

HOW TO USE MGISPEC

Good vision plays an important role in supporting daily activities and overall quality of life. To promote comfortable use and help maintain eye health, please follow these guidelines:

  1. Wear MGISPEC regularly for at least 8–10 hours per day, particularly during your daily activities.
  2. If you have a high degree of myopia (nearsightedness), hyperopia (farsightedness), or astigmatism, it is recommended that you consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional. MGISPEC lenses can be replaced with prescription lenses tailored to your individual vision needs by a qualified optical professional or based on the recommendation of an ophthalmologist.
  3. If you experience eye discomfort, eye-related symptoms, or changes in your vision, do not rely solely on wearing eyeglasses. You are advised to consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional for appropriate examination, evaluation, and treatment.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

MGISPEC products are not a substitute for professional medical examination, diagnosis, medication, or treatment. If you experience eye discomfort, vision problems, or have an existing eye condition, please consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional.

HOW TO CARE FOR YOUR MGISPEC

To help maintain the cleanliness, comfort, and overall condition of your MGISPEC eyewear, please follow these care instructions:

  1. Fold the temples before placing down or storing your eyewear. Avoid placing the glasses with the front surface of the lenses directly against a table or any other surface to help prevent scratches.
  2. Clean the lenses with clean water or a lens-cleaning solution specifically designed for eyeglasses. If oil, dust, perspiration, or other residue is difficult to remove, gently wipe the lenses with a clean, soft microfiber cloth.
  3. Store your eyewear in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Under normal storage conditions, keep the product at a temperature between 0°C and 45°C.
  4. Avoid prolonged exposure to extreme temperatures. Do not leave the product at temperatures below –10°C or above 45°C for extended periods, as extreme temperatures may cause deformation or changes in the shape of certain parts of the eyewear.
  5. Use mild soap when necessary and clean the lenses with a soft microfiber cloth. Do not use tissues, paper towels, or other rough materials, as they may scratch the lens surface.
  6. Avoid household cleaning products and alcohol. Clean your eyewear regularly to help prevent the accumulation of dust, oil, perspiration, and other residue.

Beyond Vision. Beyond Protection.

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 系列融合了高性能 ULTEM 材料、纳米科技、人体工学设计，以及先进功能性镜框与镜片技术（Advanced Functional Frame & Lens Technology），在舒适性、耐用性、眼部防护与优雅外观之间实现理想平衡。

凭借轻盈、柔韧、坚固且舒适的结构设计，MGISPEC UT157 成为注重品质、科技与专业形象人士的理想选择。

什么是 ULTEM 材料？

同样应用于航空航天工业的先进高性能材料科技

ULTEM（聚醚酰亚胺，Polyetherimide/PEI）是一种高性能工程热塑性塑料，以其轻量化结构、优异的机械强度、良好的尺寸稳定性、灵活的设计适应性以及出色的耐高温性能而著称。

凭借这些卓越特性，ULTEM 成为多个高科技工业领域的重要工程材料之一，其中包括航空及航空航天工业（Aerospace Industry）。

在航空航天领域，ULTEM 被应用于特定零部件，包括飞机内饰部件、电气组件，以及其他对材料轻量化、机械强度、稳定性和安全标准具有严格要求的工程应用。

ULTEM 在航空工业中的应用，充分体现了这种先进材料的工程技术价值，尤其适用于高度重视重量效率、机械耐用性及材料性能的应用领域。

MGISPEC ULTEM UT157 系列将这种高性能材料科技的优势融入现代眼镜设计之中，结合轻盈结构、良好柔韧性、坚固耐用的特性，以及全天候舒适佩戴体验。

源自航空航天领域的先进材料科技，如今融入 MGISPEC 高端眼镜设计。

ULTEM 材料的六大核心优势

1. EXTREMELY LIGHTWEIGHT — 极致轻盈

ULTEM 材料能够在保持结构强度的同时，实现轻量化镜框设计。

轻盈的重量有助于减轻鼻梁与耳部承受的压力，提升长时间佩戴时的舒适度。

2. STRONG & DURABLE — 坚固耐用

ULTEM 具有良好的机械强度和耐用性，适合日常使用。

其材料特性有助于保持镜框结构稳定，并在正确使用与保养的情况下延长产品的使用寿命。

12 ADVANCED FUNCTIONAL MATERIALS

镜框与镜腿中的 12 种先进功能性材料及成分

  1. 黑碧玺（BLACK TOURMALINE）

黑碧玺是一种天然矿物，以其能够自然产生负离子及释放远红外线（FIR）的独特特性而闻名。

黑碧玺的两大主要功能：

  • 产生负离子： 有助于营造更加清新、舒适的环境。
  • 释放远红外线（FIR）： 能够自然释放波长处于4–14微米（µm）安全范围内的远红外能量。

在日常应用中的潜在益处：

  • 有助于提升眼部舒适度。
  • 有助于促进微循环。
  • 提供放松舒缓的效果。
  • 有助于提升长时间佩戴的舒适性。

在MGISPEC眼镜中，经过精细研磨的黑碧玺粉末被精准地融入镜框材料中，以充分发挥其负离子及远红外线功能。

  1. 负离子（NEGATIVE IONS）

负离子被誉为“空气中的维生素”，在帮助提升眼部舒适度及降低眼睛疲劳风险方面发挥着重要作用。

负离子在MGISPEC眼镜中的功能：

  • 有助于减轻长时间使用所引起的眼睛疲劳。
  • 专为提升日常活动中的眼部舒适度而设计，尤其适用于使用数码电子设备时。
  • 佩戴眼镜时，有助于让眼部感受到更加放松与舒适。
  • 有助于提升眼周及太阳穴区域的舒适度。

在MGISPEC临床报告中，负离子被列为潜在作用机制之一，其作用可能与中和自由基、减少氧化应激及调节自主神经系统有关，并可能有助于眼部肌肉放松及提升眼部舒适度。

  1. 远红外线（FAR-INFRARED / FIR）

远红外线（FIR）的安全波长范围为4–14 µm（微米）。

微米是一种用于测量极微小长度的单位。

  • 1微米（µm）= 0.001毫米（mm）。
  • 4 µm = 4,000纳米（nm）。
  • 14 µm = 14,000纳米（nm）。

因此，4–14 µm表示波长介于4,000至14,000纳米之间的红外线。

远红外线（FIR）：4–14 µm（4,000–14,000 nm）

远红外线（FIR）在MGISPEC眼镜中的益处：

  • 有助于改善受压部位的血液循环。
  • 有助于缓解眼周肌肉疲劳。
  • 有助于促进湿气的吸收与排出，减少闷热及黏腻感。
  • 提供辅助性的抗菌及除臭效果。
  • 有助于中和静电。

此外，MGISPEC临床报告指出，波长范围为4–14 µm的远红外线可能是一种潜在的作用机制，有助于促进毛细血管扩张，并改善睫状肌、视网膜及脉络膜的血液供应，从而可能支持眼部微循环、提升眼部舒适度及维持视觉功能。

  1. 纳米银（NANO SILVER）

一种具有强效、广谱抗菌、抗病毒及抗真菌能力的材料技术。

在材料科学领域，银在特定应用及配方中具有公认的抗微生物特性。在MGISPEC眼镜中，纳米银作为纳米材料技术的一部分，被应用于镜框及镜腿材料系统中。

  1. 锗（GERMANIUM / Ge）

一种具有半导体特性的功能性材料技术，与其他矿物成分相结合，构成MGISPEC综合材料系统的一部分。

  • 有助于调节人体微弱生物电流，以缓解神经紧张。
  • 有助于增强远红外线（FIR）的共振作用，支持局部微循环。
  • 有助于产生微量负离子，以中和电磁静电。
  • 有助于提供抗菌方面的舒适体验，并降低皮肤过敏风险。
  • 有助于维持温度稳定，并减少因出汗而产生的湿气。
  • 有助于发挥良好的抗氧化作用。
  1. 石墨烯（GRAPHENE）

一种先进的碳基功能性材料技术，具有高强度、轻量化以及优异的物理和导热特性。

  • 有助于快速散热，减少闷热及黏腻感（核心优势）。
  • 支持远红外线（FIR）功能，有助于减少眼周压痕及不适感。
  • 提供轻微的抗静电及负离子作用，有助于减少灰尘积聚。
  • 有助于全面提升眼镜框架的耐用性（附加优势）。
  1. 竹炭（BAMBOO CHARCOAL）

一种具有多孔结构的碳基材料技术，作为MGISPEC功能性材料配方的组成部分。

  • 有助于吸附异味、油脂及汗液（主要优势）。
  • 有助于调节湿度，保持佩戴时的干爽舒适，减少黏腻感。
  • 可释放轻微的远红外线（FIR），有助于支持局部血液循环。
  • 提供物理性抗菌效果，作为辅助功能。
  1. 功能性矿物复合配方（FUNCTIONAL MINERAL BLEND）

由多种精选矿物组合而成，旨在作为一体化材料系统的一部分协同发挥作用，并支持MGISPEC所含各项成分的功能。

  1. 氧化锌（ZINC OXIDE / ZnO）

氧化锌因其稳定性及功能特性而广泛应用于材料技术领域，同时也是MGISPEC纳米材料配方的组成部分。

  • 有助于提供持久的广谱抗菌效果。

  • 有助于提供适度的导热与散热效果，减少闷热及黏腻感。
  • 有助于增强镜框材料的强度，提高其耐磨性及抗变形能力。
  1. 二氧化钛（TITANIUM DIOXIDE / TiO₂）

一种稳定性良好的材料，广泛应用于多种材料技术领域，并作为MGISPEC功能性材料系统的组成部分。

  • 有助于提供强效紫外线防护，防止镜框泛黄（金红石型的主要优势）。

  • 具有较低的表面能、抗油污特性，并且易于清洁。
  • 具有较高的化学稳定性，且过敏风险较低。
  1. 二氧化锆（ZIRCONIUM DIOXIDE / ZrO₂）

一种以良好稳定性及优异机械性能著称的陶瓷材料，可支持专为日常使用而设计的镜框材料配方。

  • 具有极高的耐磨性、抗刮擦能力，以及抵抗表面泛白变色的能力。
  • 具有生物惰性，亲肤性良好，过敏风险较低（主要优势）。
  • 有助于维持尺寸稳定性，减少温度变化引起的热胀冷缩影响。
  • 有助于释放波长范围为4–14 µm的中等强度远红外线（FIR）。

  1. 纳米二氧化硅（NANO SILICA / SiO₂）

一种用于支持材料物理特性及整体材料系统稳定性的纳米材料。

  • 有助于减少表面黏腻感、抵抗油污，并使清洁更加方便。
  • 有助于形成细腻光滑的哑光质感，提升佩戴舒适度。
  • 有助于增强抵抗紫外线引起的老化能力，并防止镜框泛黄。

作用： 在特定材料配方中，可帮助提高硬度、稳定性及抗刮擦性能。

9 ADVANCED LENS PROTECTION FEATURES

九项先进镜片防护功能，满足日常用眼需求

1. BLUE LIGHT FILTERING — 蓝光过滤

镜片设计用于过滤特定波长范围内的部分蓝光。

益处： 帮助减少透过镜片的蓝光量。具体过滤比例及其对视觉舒适度的影响，仍需通过适当的光学测试与评估确认。

2. UVA & UVB PROTECTION (UV400) — UVA 与 UVB 紫外线防护

镜片设计用于提供最高至 400 纳米波长范围的 UVA 与 UVB 紫外线防护。

益处： 帮助减少眼睛受到的紫外线照射。适当的紫外线防护是长期维护眼部健康的重要措施之一。

3. SCRATCH-RESISTANT SURFACE — 抗刮擦表面

镜片表面经过专门设计，以提升对日常轻微刮擦的抵抗能力。

益处： 有助于维持镜片的光学清晰度及长期视觉舒适性。

4. SHATTER-RESISTANT CONSTRUCTION — 抗碎裂结构

镜片结构设计旨在降低受到特定压力或冲击时破裂成尖锐碎片的风险。

益处： 与较易碎裂的镜片材料相比，有助于提高使用安全性，具体性能应以产品测试结果为依据。

5. HIGH IMPACT RESISTANCE — 高抗冲击性能

镜片材料经过设计，以承受正常活动中可能出现的冲击。

益处： 提供额外的机械防护，但不能替代经过认证的工业安全防护眼镜。

6. OIL-REPELLENT SURFACE — 防油污表面

镜片表面设计用于减少油脂、指纹及部分污渍的附着。

益处： 使镜片更容易清洁，并有助于保持清晰视野。

7. ELECTROMAGNETIC RADIATION (EMF) — 电磁辐射相关功能

镜片材料技术采用针对特定光线及电磁辐射范围进行相互作用管理的设计理念。

益处： 相关波段的过滤性能必须经过专门测试验证。此功能不应被理解为能够全面阻隔所有类型的电磁辐射。

8. ANTI-STATIC PERFORMANCE — 抗静电性能

镜片表面技术旨在帮助减少静电荷的积累。

益处： 有助于降低灰尘附着在镜片表面的可能性，从而支持镜片清洁及视觉舒适性。

9. CORROSION RESISTANCE — 耐腐蚀性能

镜片材料及表面经过设计，以抵抗某些可能影响表面品质的环境条件。

益处： 在适当使用和保养的情况下，有助于保持材料稳定性、表面品质及镜片耐用性。

MGISPEC 临床试验结果

MGISPEC 功能眼镜科技已在天津华厦眼科医院进行前瞻性、随机、平行对照临床试验。研究共纳入 150 名受试者，分为三组，每天佩戴至少 8 小时，连续 15 天。

15 天后，MGISPEC 组视觉疲劳评分为 12.23 ± 1.34；普通光学眼镜组为 17.87 ± 2.11；传统蓝光过滤眼镜组为 15.15 ± 1.77（P=0.002）。视力改善总体有效率达到 90%，干眼症状总体缓解率达到 92%，且未报告严重不良事件。

重要说明：临床试验评估的是 MGISPEC 负离子、远红外与蓝光过滤功能眼镜的整体技术系统，而不是证明每一种材料单独具有医疗治疗效果。上述材料功能说明主要体现材料特性及临床报告中讨论的潜在作用机制。

MGISPEC 使用指南

良好的视力对于日常生活、工作以及整体生活质量都十分重要。为了提升佩戴舒适度并帮助维护眼部健康，请遵循以下使用建议：

  1. 建议每天规律佩戴 MGISPEC 至少 8–10 小时，尤其是在进行日常活动时。
  2. 如果您有较高度数的近视、远视或散光，建议咨询眼科医生或专业视光人员。MGISPEC 镜片可根据您的实际视力需求，通过专业眼镜店或依据眼科医生的建议，更换为适合您个人视力需求的处方镜片。
  3. 如果您出现眼部不适、眼部症状或视力变化，请勿仅依赖佩戴眼镜。建议及时咨询眼科医生或专业视光人员，进行适当的检查、评估及治疗。

重要提示

MGISPEC 产品不能替代专业的医学检查、诊断、药物或医疗治疗。如果您出现眼部不适、视力问题，或患有其他眼部疾病，请咨询眼科医生或专业视光人员。

MGISPEC 保养指南

为了帮助保持 MGISPEC 眼镜的清洁、舒适度及良好状态，请遵循以下保养方法：

  1. 放置或收纳眼镜前，请先折叠镜腿。 请避免将镜片正面直接朝下放置在桌面或其他表面上，以帮助防止镜片刮伤。
  2. 请使用清水或眼镜镜片专用清洁液清洁镜片。 如果镜片上的油脂、灰尘、汗渍或其他污渍难以清除，请使用干净、柔软的超细纤维布轻轻擦拭。
  3. 请将眼镜存放在阴凉、干燥的环境中，并避免阳光直射。正常存放温度建议保持在 0°C 至 45°C 之间。
  4. 避免长时间暴露于极端温度环境中。 请勿将产品长时间置于 –10°C 以下或 45°C 以上的环境中，因为极端温度可能导致眼镜的某些部件发生变形或形状变化。
  5. 必要时可使用温和的肥皂清洁，并使用柔软的超细纤维布擦拭镜片。 请勿使用纸巾、纸巾类清洁用品或其他粗糙材质擦拭镜片，以免刮伤镜片表面。
  6. 避免使用家用清洁剂或酒精清洁眼镜。 请定期清洁眼镜，以帮助减少灰尘、油脂、汗渍及其他污垢的积聚。

APA ITU MATERIAL ULTEM?

TEKNOLOGI MATERIAL CANGGIH YANG JUGA DIGUNAKAN DALAM INDUSTRI PENERBANGAN

ULTEM (Polyetherimide/PEI) merupakan material termoplastik rekayasa berkinerja tinggi yang dikenal memiliki kombinasi luar biasa antara bobot ringan, kekuatan mekanis, kestabilan dimensi, fleksibilitas desain, serta ketahanan terhadap suhu tinggi.

Keunggulan tersebut menjadikan ULTEM salah satu material teknik penting yang digunakan dalam berbagai industri berteknologi tinggi, termasuk industri penerbangan dan dirgantara (Aerospace Industry).

Dalam industri penerbangan, ULTEM digunakan pada komponen tertentu, seperti bagian interior pesawat, komponen kelistrikan, serta aplikasi teknik khusus yang membutuhkan material ringan, kuat, stabil, dan memenuhi persyaratan keselamatan yang ketat.

Penggunaan ULTEM dalam industri penerbangan menunjukkan nilai teknologi material ini, terutama dalam aplikasi yang mengutamakan efisiensi bobot, ketahanan mekanis, dan performa material.

MGISPEC ULTEM UT158 SERIES membawa keunggulan material berteknologi tinggi tersebut ke dalam desain kacamata modern, menghadirkan bingkai yang ringan, fleksibel, tahan lama, dan nyaman digunakan sepanjang hari.

DARI TEKNOLOGI MATERIAL INDUSTRI PENERBANGAN, KINI HADIR DALAM KACAMATA PREMIUM MGISPEC.

6 KEUNGGULAN UTAMA MATERIAL ULTEM

1. EXTREMELY LIGHTWEIGHT — SANGAT RINGAN

Material ULTEM memungkinkan pembuatan bingkai yang ringan tanpa mengorbankan kekuatan strukturalnya.

Bobot yang ringan membantu mengurangi tekanan pada hidung dan telinga sehingga meningkatkan kenyamanan, terutama ketika digunakan dalam waktu lama.

2. STRONG & DURABLE — KUAT DAN TAHAN LAMA

ULTEM memiliki kekuatan mekanis dan ketahanan yang baik terhadap penggunaan sehari-hari.

Karakteristik ini membantu menjaga struktur bingkai tetap stabil serta mendukung masa pakai produk yang lebih panjang dengan penggunaan dan perawatan yang tepat.

3. EXCELLENT FLEXIBILITY — FLEKSIBILITAS YANG BAIK

Material ULTEM memungkinkan desain bingkai dengan fleksibilitas yang mendukung kenyamanan penggunaan.

Kelenturan yang dirancang secara tepat membantu mengurangi risiko kerusakan akibat tekanan ringan selama aktivitas normal.

4. HEAT & STEAM RESISTANT — TAHAN PANAS DAN UAP

ULTEM merupakan material teknik dengan ketahanan termal tinggi.

Jenis ULTEM tertentu dapat digunakan dalam aplikasi yang membutuhkan ketahanan terhadap suhu sekitar 170°C, bergantung pada kelas material, durasi paparan, dan kondisi pengujian.

Karakteristik ini membantu menjaga kestabilan material bingkai terhadap perubahan suhu dalam penggunaan normal. Namun, kacamata tetap perlu dijauhkan dari panas ekstrem secara langsung.

5. SKIN-FRIENDLY COMFORT — NYAMAN BERSENTUHAN DENGAN KULIT

ULTEM yang diproses dengan tepat dapat menghasilkan permukaan bingkai yang halus dan nyaman saat bersentuhan dengan kulit.

Desainnya yang ringan membantu mengurangi tekanan pada area hidung dan telinga selama pemakaian. Kesesuaian bagi kulit sensitif tetap bergantung pada formulasi produk dan kondisi masing-masing pengguna.

6. IDEAL FOR EVERYDAY EYEWEAR — IDEAL UNTUK KACAMATA SEHARI-HARI

Kombinasi bobot ringan, kekuatan, fleksibilitas, dan desain ergonomis menjadikan ULTEM pilihan material yang sangat baik untuk kacamata modern.

Material ini mendukung kenyamanan dan ketahanan yang dibutuhkan dalam berbagai aktivitas sehari-hari.

12 MATERIAL DAN KOMPONEN FUNGSIONAL PADA BINGKAI & TANGKAI

  1. TOURMALIN HITAM (BLACK TOURMALINE)

Tourmalin hitam adalah mineral alami yang dikenal memiliki sifat unik dalam menghasilkan Ion Negatif dan memancarkan Far-Infrared (FIR) secara alami.

Dua Fungsi Utama Tourmalin Hitam menghasilkan Ion Negatif yang Membantu menciptakan lingkungan yang lebih segar dan nyaman dan Infra Merah Jauh (FIR) yang memancarkan energi inframerah jauh alami dalam rentang aman 4–14 mikrometer (µm).

Manfaat Potensial dalam Aplikasi Keseharian

  • Mendukung kenyamanan mata.
  • Membantu sirkulasi mikro.
  • Memberikan efek relaksasi.
  • Mendukung kenyamanan pemakaian jangka panjang.

Dalam MGISPEC, Serbuk halus tourmalin hitam diintegrasikan ke dalam material bingkai secara presisi untuk memberikan fungsi ion negatif dan FIR secara optimal.

2. ION NEGATIF

Ion Negatif adalah "Vitamin dalam Udara" yang sangat berperan penting dalam membantu kenyamanan mata serta mengurangi resiko kelelahan mata.

Fungsi Ion Negatif pada MGISPEC :

  • Membantu mengurangi kelelahan mata akibat penggunaan dalam waktu yang lama.
  • Dirancang untuk mendukung kenyamanan mata selama aktivitas sehari-hari, terutama saat menggunakan perangkat digital.
  • Membantu memberikan sensasi lebih rileks dan nyaman pada mata saat mengenakan kacamata.
  • Mendukung kenyamanan di sekitar area mata dan pelipis.

Dalam laporan klinis MGISPEC, ion negatif dibahas sebagai salah satu mekanisme potensial yang berkaitan dengan netralisasi radikal bebas, pengurangan stres oksidatif, dan regulasi otonom yang berpotensi mendukung relaksasi otot okular serta kenyamanan mata

  1. INFRA MERAH JAUH (FAR-INFRARED / FIR)

Infra merah Jauh (FIR) mempunyai rentang panjang gelombang yang aman yaitu 4–14 µm (micrometer).

Mikrometer merupakan satuan ukuran panjang yang sangat kecil.

  • 1 mikrometer (µm) = 0,001 milimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4.000 nanometer (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14.000 nanometer (nm).

Jadi, 4–14 µm berarti panjang gelombang inframerah antara 4.000 hingga 14.000 nanometer.

FIR 4–14 µm (4.000–14.000 nm)

Manfaat Infra merah jauh (FIR) pada MGISPEC

  • Membantu meningkatkan Sirkulasi Darah pada Area yang Mengalami Tekanan.
  • Membantu meredakan Kelelahan Otot di Sekitar Mata.
  • Membantu penyerapan dan Pengeluaran Kelembapan untuk Mengurangi Rasa Gerah dan Lengket.
  • Sebagai Efek Pendukung Antibakteri dan Penghilang Bau.
  • Membantu menetralkan Listrik Statis.

Selain itu, FIR pada rentang 4–14 μm dibahas dalam laporan klinis MGISPEC sebagai mekanisme potensial yang dapat mendukung dilatasi kapiler dan suplai darah ke otot siliaris, retina, dan koroid, sehingga berpotensi mendukung mikrosirkulasi okular, kenyamanan, dan fungsi visual.

9 FITUR PERLINDUNGAN LENSA UNTUK AKTIVITAS SEHARI-HARI

1. BLUE LIGHT FILTERING — PENYARINGAN CAHAYA BIRU

Lensa dirancang untuk menyaring sebagian cahaya biru pada rentang panjang gelombang tertentu.

Manfaat: Membantu mengurangi jumlah cahaya biru yang diteruskan melalui lensa. Tingkat penyaringan dan manfaat terhadap kenyamanan visual perlu didukung pengujian optik serta evaluasi yang sesuai.

2. UVA & UVB PROTECTION (UV400) — PERLINDUNGAN SINAR ULTRAVIOLET

Lensa dirancang untuk memberikan perlindungan terhadap radiasi ultraviolet UVA dan UVB hingga panjang gelombang 400 nm.

Manfaat: Membantu mengurangi paparan radiasi UV pada mata. Perlindungan UV yang memadai merupakan bagian penting dalam menjaga kesehatan mata jangka panjang.

3. SCRATCH-RESISTANT SURFACE — PERMUKAAN TAHAN GORES

Permukaan lensa dirancang untuk meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap goresan ringan akibat penggunaan sehari-hari.

Manfaat: Membantu menjaga kejernihan optik lensa dan kenyamanan penglihatan dalam jangka panjang.

4. SHATTER-RESISTANT CONSTRUCTION — KONSTRUKSI TAHAN PECAH

Konstruksi lensa dirancang untuk mengurangi risiko pecah menjadi serpihan tajam ketika menerima tekanan atau benturan tertentu.

Manfaat: Membantu meningkatkan keamanan penggunaan dibandingkan material lensa yang lebih mudah pecah, sesuai hasil pengujian ketahanan produk.

5. HIGH IMPACT RESISTANCE — KETAHANAN BENTURAN TINGGI

Material lensa dirancang memiliki ketahanan terhadap benturan dalam aktivitas normal.

Manfaat: Memberikan perlindungan mekanis tambahan bagi pengguna. Namun, kacamata ini bukan pengganti kacamata keselamatan industri yang tersertifikasi.

6. OIL-REPELLENT SURFACE — PERMUKAAN PENOLAK MINYAK

Permukaan lensa dirancang untuk mengurangi daya lekat minyak, sidik jari, dan kotoran tertentu.

Manfaat: Membantu mempermudah pembersihan dan mempertahankan kejernihan penglihatan.

7. ELECTROMAGNETIC RADIATION (EMF) — FITUR TERKAIT RADIASI ELEKTROMAGNETIK

Teknologi material lensa dikembangkan dengan konsep pengelolaan interaksi terhadap cahaya dan radiasi elektromagnetik pada rentang tertentu.

Manfaat: Karakteristik penyaringan pada rentang yang relevan harus dibuktikan melalui pengujian khusus. Fitur ini tidak berarti perlindungan menyeluruh terhadap seluruh jenis radiasi elektromagnetik.

8. ANTI-STATIC PERFORMANCE — PERLINDUNGAN ANTISTATIS

Teknologi permukaan lensa dirancang untuk membantu mengurangi akumulasi muatan listrik statis.

Manfaat: Berpotensi mengurangi kecenderungan debu menempel pada permukaan lensa sehingga membantu menjaga kebersihan dan kenyamanan penglihatan.

9. CORROSION RESISTANCE — KETAHANAN TERHADAP KOROSI

Material dan permukaan lensa dirancang memiliki ketahanan terhadap kondisi lingkungan tertentu yang dapat memengaruhi kualitas permukaan.

Manfaat: Membantu menjaga kestabilan material, kualitas permukaan, dan daya tahan lensa selama penggunaan serta perawatan yang sesuai.

HASIL UJI KLINIS TEKNOLOGI MGISPEC

Teknologi kacamata fungsional MGISPEC telah dievaluasi dalam uji klinis prospektif, acak, dan terkontrol secara paralel di Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. Penelitian melibatkan 150 peserta yang dibagi menjadi tiga kelompok, dengan penggunaan kacamata sedikitnya 8 jam per hari selama 15 hari.

Setelah 15 hari, kelompok MGISPEC mencatat skor kelelahan visual 12,23 ± 1,34, dibandingkan 17,87 ± 2,11 pada kelompok kacamata optik biasa dan 15,15 ± 1,77 pada kelompok kacamata penyaring cahaya biru konvensional (P=0,002). Tingkat efektivitas keseluruhan untuk peningkatan ketajaman penglihatan mencapai 90%, sedangkan tingkat perbaikan keseluruhan gejala mata kering mencapai 92%. Tidak dilaporkan kejadian tidak diinginkan serius.

Catatan penting: uji klinis mengevaluasi sistem teknologi kacamata MGISPEC secara keseluruhan—Negative Ion, Far-Infrared dan blue-light filtering—bukan membuktikan bahwa setiap material secara individual memiliki efek terapi. Penjelasan fungsi material di atas menggambarkan karakteristik material dan mekanisme potensial yang dibahas dalam laporan klinis.

CARA MENGGUNAKAN MGISPEC

Penglihatan yang baik merupakan bagian penting dalam menunjang aktivitas dan kualitas hidup sehari-hari. Untuk mendukung kenyamanan penggunaan dan membantu menjaga kesehatan mata, perhatikan panduan berikut:

  1. Gunakan MGISPEC secara rutin selama minimal 8–10 jam per hari, terutama saat menjalani aktivitas sehari-hari.
  2. Apabila Anda memiliki kelainan refraksi dengan ukuran minus, plus, atau silinder yang tinggi, disarankan untuk berkonsultasi dengan dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata. Lensa MGISPEC dapat diganti dengan lensa resep yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan penglihatan Anda melalui optik profesional atau berdasarkan rekomendasi dokter mata.
  3. Apabila Anda mengalami keluhan pada mata atau perubahan pada penglihatan, jangan hanya mengandalkan penggunaan kacamata. Tetap disarankan untuk memeriksakan kondisi mata kepada dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata guna mendapatkan pemeriksaan dan penanganan yang sesuai.

PERHATIAN

Produk MGISPEC bukan merupakan pengganti pemeriksaan, diagnosis, obat-obatan, maupun perawatan medis profesional. Apabila Anda memiliki keluhan, gangguan penglihatan, atau kondisi kesehatan mata tertentu, konsultasikan dengan dokter mata atau tenaga profesional kesehatan mata.

CARA MERAWAT MGISPEC

Untuk membantu menjaga kebersihan, kenyamanan, dan kondisi kacamata MGISPEC agar tetap optimal, ikuti petunjuk perawatan berikut:

  1. Lipat tangkai kacamata sebelum meletakkan atau menyimpannya. Hindari meletakkan kacamata dengan permukaan depan lensa menghadap langsung ke meja atau permukaan lainnya untuk membantu mencegah goresan.
  2. Bersihkan lensa menggunakan air bersih atau cairan pembersih khusus lensa kacamata. Apabila terdapat minyak, debu, keringat, atau kotoran yang sulit dibersihkan, usap lensa secara perlahan menggunakan kain mikrofiber yang bersih dan lembut.
  3. Simpan kacamata di tempat yang sejuk dan kering, serta terlindung dari paparan sinar matahari langsung. Untuk penyimpanan normal, simpan pada suhu antara 0°C hingga 45°C.
  4. Hindari paparan suhu ekstrem dalam waktu lama. Jangan membiarkan produk berada pada suhu di bawah –10°C atau di atas 45°C dalam waktu yang berkepanjangan karena dapat menyebabkan perubahan bentuk atau deformasi pada bagian tertentu dari kacamata.
  5. Gunakan sabun yang lembut. Gunakan kain microfiber. (Jangan gunakan tisu atau bahan kain lain yang kasar.),
  6. Hindari penggunaan pembersih rumah tangga dan alkohol, Bersihkan kacamata secara rutin.

WHAT IS ULTEM MATERIAL?

ADVANCED HIGH-PERFORMANCE MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY ALSO USED IN THE AEROSPACE INDUSTRY

ULTEM (Polyetherimide/PEI) is a high-performance engineering thermoplastic recognized for its exceptional combination of lightweight construction, mechanical strength, dimensional stability, design flexibility, and high-temperature resistance.

These outstanding properties make ULTEM an important engineering material used across various high-technology industries, including the aviation and aerospace industry.

In aerospace applications, ULTEM is used in selected components, including aircraft interior parts, electrical components, and specialized engineering applications requiring lightweight, strong, stable materials that meet stringent safety requirements.

Its use in the aerospace industry demonstrates the advanced engineering value of this material, particularly in applications where weight efficiency, mechanical durability, and material performance are essential.

MGISPEC ULTEM UT158 SERIES brings the advantages of this high-performance material technology into modern eyewear, combining lightweight construction, flexibility, durability, and exceptional everyday wearing comfort.

FROM AEROSPACE MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY TO PREMIUM MGISPEC EYEWEAR.

6 KEY ADVANTAGES OF ULTEM MATERIAL

1. EXTREMELY LIGHTWEIGHT

ULTEM enables the production of lightweight eyewear frames without compromising structural strength.

Its reduced weight helps minimize pressure on the nose and ears, enhancing comfort during extended wear.

2. STRONG & DURABLE

ULTEM provides excellent mechanical strength and durability for everyday use.

These characteristics help maintain frame stability and contribute to long-lasting product performance with appropriate use and care.

3. EXCELLENT FLEXIBILITY

ULTEM allows eyewear frames to be engineered with flexibility that supports everyday wearing comfort.

Properly designed flexibility helps reduce the risk of damage from minor stresses during normal activities.

4. HEAT & STEAM RESISTANT

ULTEM is an engineering material recognized for its high thermal resistance.

Certain ULTEM grades can be used in applications requiring resistance to temperatures of approximately 170°C, depending on the material grade, exposure duration, and testing conditions.

This characteristic helps maintain frame stability under normal temperature variations. However, eyewear should still be protected from direct exposure to extreme heat.

5. SKIN-FRIENDLY COMFORT

When properly processed, ULTEM can provide a smooth frame surface that feels comfortable against the skin.

Its lightweight design helps reduce pressure around the nose and ears during extended wear. Suitability for sensitive skin depends on the specific product formulation and individual conditions.

6. IDEAL FOR EVERYDAY EYEWEAR

The combination of lightweight construction, strength, flexibility, and ergonomic design makes ULTEM an excellent material choice for modern eyewear.

It supports the comfort and durability required for a wide range of everyday activities.

12 FUNCTIONAL MATERIALS AND COMPONENTS IN THE FRAME & TEMPLES

1. BLACK TOURMALINE

Black Tourmaline is a natural mineral known for its unique properties in naturally generating Negative Ions and emitting Far-Infrared (FIR) radiation.

Two Main Functions of Black Tourmaline:

  • Negative Ion Generation: Helps create a fresher and more comfortable environment.
  • Far-Infrared (FIR) Emission: Naturally emits far-infrared energy within the safe wavelength range of 4–14 micrometers (µm).

Potential Benefits in Everyday Applications:

  • Supports eye comfort.
  • Helps support microcirculation.
  • Provides a relaxing effect.
  • Supports comfort during prolonged wear.

In MGISPEC, finely powdered Black Tourmaline is precisely integrated into the frame material to optimize its Negative Ion and FIR functions.

2. NEGATIVE IONS

Negative Ions are often referred to as "Vitamins in the Air" and play an important role in supporting eye comfort and reducing the risk of eye fatigue.

Functions of Negative Ions in MGISPEC:

In the MGISPEC clinical report, Negative Ions are discussed as one of the potential mechanisms associated with free-radical neutralization, reduction of oxidative stress, and autonomic regulation, which may contribute to ocular muscle relaxation and eye comfort.

  1. FAR-INFRARED (FIR)

Far-Infrared (FIR) has a safe wavelength range of 4–14 µm (micrometers).

A micrometer is a unit used to measure extremely small lengths.

  • 1 micrometer (µm) = 0.001 millimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4,000 nanometers (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14,000 nanometers (nm).

Therefore, 4–14 µm refers to infrared wavelengths ranging from 4,000 to 14,000 nanometers.

FIR 4–14 µm (4,000–14,000 nm)

Benefits of Far-Infrared (FIR) in MGISPEC:

  • Helps neutralize static electricity.

Furthermore, FIR within the 4–14 µm wavelength range is discussed in the MGISPEC clinical report as a potential mechanism that may support capillary dilation and blood supply to the ciliary muscles, retina, and choroid, thereby potentially supporting ocular microcirculation, comfort, and visual function.

MGISPEC CLINICAL TRIAL RESULTS

MGISPEC functional eyewear technology was evaluated in a prospective, randomized, parallel-controlled clinical trial at Tianjin Huaxia Eye Hospital. The study involved 150 participants divided into three groups, with eyewear worn for at least 8 hours per day for 15 consecutive days.

After 15 days, the MGISPEC group recorded a visual-fatigue score of 12.23 ± 1.34, compared with 17.87 ± 2.11 in the ordinary optical-eyewear group and 15.15 ± 1.77 in the conventional blue-light-filtering group (P=0.002). The overall effectiveness rate for visual-acuity improvement reached 90%, while the overall relief rate for dry-eye symptoms reached 92%. No serious adverse events were reported.

Important: the clinical trial evaluated the MGISPEC eyewear Note: MGISPEC eyewear does not replace professional eye examinations, diagnosis, or medical treatment. Specific protective specifications and health-related benefits must be supported by relevant product testing.

HOW TO USE MGISPEC

Good vision plays an important role in supporting daily activities and overall quality of life. To promote comfortable use and help maintain eye health, please follow these guidelines:

  1. Wear MGISPEC regularly for at least 8–10 hours per day, particularly during your daily activities.
  2. If you have a high degree of myopia (nearsightedness), hyperopia (farsightedness), or astigmatism, it is recommended that you consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional. MGISPEC lenses can be replaced with prescription lenses tailored to your individual vision needs by a qualified optical professional or based on the recommendation of an ophthalmologist.
  3. If you experience eye discomfort, eye-related symptoms, or changes in your vision, do not rely solely on wearing eyeglasses. You are advised to consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional for appropriate examination, evaluation, and treatment.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

MGISPEC products are not a substitute for professional medical examination, diagnosis, medication, or treatment. If you experience eye discomfort, vision problems, or have an existing eye condition, please consult an ophthalmologist or qualified eye care professional.

HOW TO CARE FOR YOUR MGISPEC

To help maintain the cleanliness, comfort, and overall condition of your MGISPEC eyewear, please follow these care instructions:

  1. Fold the temples before placing down or storing your eyewear. Avoid placing the glasses with the front surface of the lenses directly against a table or any other surface to help prevent scratches.
  2. Clean the lenses with clean water or a lens-cleaning solution specifically designed for eyeglasses. If oil, dust, perspiration, or other residue is difficult to remove, gently wipe the lenses with a clean, soft microfiber cloth.
  3. Store your eyewear in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Under normal storage conditions, keep the product at a temperature between 0°C and 45°C.
  4. Avoid prolonged exposure to extreme temperatures. Do not leave the product at temperatures below –10°C or above 45°C for extended periods, as extreme temperatures may cause deformation or changes in the shape of certain parts of the eyewear.
  5. Use mild soap when necessary and clean the lenses with a soft microfiber cloth. Do not use tissues, paper towels, or other rough materials, as they may scratch the lens surface.
  6. Avoid household cleaning products and alcohol. Clean your eyewear regularly to help prevent the accumulation of dust, oil, perspiration, and other residue.

什么是 ULTEM 材料？

同样应用于航空航天工业的先进高性能材料科技

ULTEM（聚醚酰亚胺，Polyetherimide/PEI）是一种高性能工程热塑性塑料，以其轻量化结构、优异的机械强度、良好的尺寸稳定性、灵活的设计适应性以及出色的耐高温性能而著称。

凭借这些卓越特性，ULTEM 成为多个高科技工业领域的重要工程材料之一，其中包括航空及航空航天工业（Aerospace Industry）。

在航空航天领域，ULTEM 被应用于特定零部件，包括飞机内饰部件、电气组件，以及其他对材料轻量化、机械强度、稳定性和安全标准具有严格要求的工程应用。

ULTEM 在航空工业中的应用，充分体现了这种先进材料的工程技术价值，尤其适用于高度重视重量效率、机械耐用性及材料性能的应用领域。

MGISPEC ULTEM UT158 系列将这种高性能材料科技的优势融入现代眼镜设计之中，结合轻盈结构、良好柔韧性、坚固耐用的特性，以及全天候舒适佩戴体验。

源自航空航天领域的先进材料科技，如今融入 MGISPEC 高端眼镜设计。

12 ADVANCED FUNCTIONAL MATERIALS

镜框与镜腿中的 12 种先进功能性材料及成分

  1. 黑碧玺（BLACK TOURMALINE）

黑碧玺是一种天然矿物，以其能够自然产生负离子及释放远红外线（FIR）的独特特性而闻名。

黑碧玺的两大主要功能：

  • 产生负离子： 有助于营造更加清新、舒适的环境。
  • 释放远红外线（FIR）： 能够自然释放波长处于4–14微米（µm）安全范围内的远红外能量。

在日常应用中的潜在益处：

  • 有助于提升眼部舒适度。
  • 有助于促进微循环。
  • 提供放松舒缓的效果。
  • 有助于提升长时间佩戴的舒适性。

在MGISPEC眼镜中，经过精细研磨的黑碧玺粉末被精准地融入镜框材料中，以充分发挥其负离子及远红外线功能。

  1. 负离子（NEGATIVE IONS）

负离子被誉为“空气中的维生素”，在帮助提升眼部舒适度及降低眼睛疲劳风险方面发挥着重要作用。

负离子在MGISPEC眼镜中的功能：

  • 有助于减轻长时间使用所引起的眼睛疲劳。
  • 专为提升日常活动中的眼部舒适度而设计，尤其适用于使用数码电子设备时。
  • 佩戴眼镜时，有助于让眼部感受到更加放松与舒适。
  • 有助于提升眼周及太阳穴区域的舒适度。

在MGISPEC临床报告中，负离子被列为潜在作用机制之一，其作用可能与中和自由基、减少氧化应激及调节自主神经系统有关，并可能有助于眼部肌肉放松及提升眼部舒适度。

  1. 远红外线（FAR-INFRARED / FIR）

远红外线（FIR）的安全波长范围为4–14 µm（微米）。

微米是一种用于测量极微小长度的单位。

  • 1微米（µm）= 0.001毫米（mm）。
  • 4 µm = 4,000纳米（nm）。
  • 14 µm = 14,000纳米（nm）。

因此，4–14 µm表示波长介于4,000至14,000纳米之间的红外线。

远红外线（FIR）：4–14 µm（4,000–14,000 nm）

远红外线（FIR）在MGISPEC眼镜中的益处：

  • 有助于改善受压部位的血液循环。
  • 有助于缓解眼周肌肉疲劳。
  • 有助于促进湿气的吸收与排出，减少闷热及黏腻感。
  • 提供辅助性的抗菌及除臭效果。
  • 有助于中和静电。

此外，MGISPEC临床报告指出，波长范围为4–14 µm的远红外线可能是一种潜在的作用机制，有助于促进毛细血管扩张，并改善睫状肌、视网膜及脉络膜的血液供应，从而可能支持眼部微循环、提升眼部舒适度及维持视觉功能。

MGISPEC 临床试验结果

MGISPEC 功能眼镜科技已在天津华厦眼科医院进行前瞻性、随机、平行对照临床试验。研究共纳入 150 名受试者，分为三组，每天佩戴至少 8 小时，连续 15 天。

15 天后，MGISPEC 组视觉疲劳评分为 12.23 ± 1.34；普通光学眼镜组为 17.87 ± 2.11；传统蓝光过滤眼镜组为 15.15 ± 1.77（P=0.002）。视力改善总体有效率达到 90%，干眼症状总体缓解率达到 92%，且未报告严重不良事件。

重要说明：临床试验评估的是 MGISPEC 负离子、远红外与蓝光过滤功能眼镜的整体技术系统，而不是证明每一种材料单独具有医疗治疗效果。上述材料功能说明主要体现材料特性及临床报告中讨论的潜在作用机制。

MGISPEC 保养指南

为了帮助保持 MGISPEC 眼镜的清洁、舒适度及良好状态，请遵循以下保养方法：

  1. 放置或收纳眼镜前，请先折叠镜腿。 请避免将镜片正面直接朝下放置在桌面或其他表面上，以帮助防止镜片刮伤。
  2. 请使用清水或眼镜镜片专用清洁液清洁镜片。 如果镜片上的油脂、灰尘、汗渍或其他污渍难以清除，请使用干净、柔软的超细纤维布轻轻擦拭。
  3. 请将眼镜存放在阴凉、干燥的环境中，并避免阳光直射。正常存放温度建议保持在 0°C 至 45°C 之间。
  4. 避免长时间暴露于极端温度环境中。 请勿将产品长时间置于 –10°C 以下或 45°C 以上的环境中，因为极端温度可能导致眼镜的某些部件发生变形或形状变化。
  5. 必要时可使用温和的肥皂清洁，并使用柔软的超细纤维布擦拭镜片。 请勿使用纸巾、纸巾类清洁用品或其他粗糙材质擦拭镜片，以免刮伤镜片表面。
  6. 避免使用家用清洁剂或酒精清洁眼镜。 请定期清洁眼镜，以帮助减少灰尘、油脂、汗渍及其他污垢的积聚。

APA ITU MATERIAL ULTEM?

TEKNOLOGI MATERIAL CANGGIH YANG JUGA DIGUNAKAN DALAM INDUSTRI PENERBANGAN

ULTEM (Polyetherimide/PEI) merupakan material termoplastik rekayasa berkinerja tinggi yang dikenal memiliki kombinasi luar biasa antara bobot ringan, kekuatan mekanis, kestabilan dimensi, fleksibilitas desain, serta ketahanan terhadap suhu tinggi.

Keunggulan tersebut menjadikan ULTEM salah satu material teknik penting yang digunakan dalam berbagai industri berteknologi tinggi, termasuk industri penerbangan dan dirgantara (Aerospace Industry).

Dalam industri penerbangan, ULTEM digunakan pada komponen tertentu, seperti bagian interior pesawat, komponen kelistrikan, serta aplikasi teknik khusus yang membutuhkan material ringan, kuat, stabil, dan memenuhi persyaratan keselamatan yang ketat.

Penggunaan ULTEM dalam industri penerbangan menunjukkan nilai teknologi material ini, terutama dalam aplikasi yang mengutamakan efisiensi bobot, ketahanan mekanis, dan performa material.

MGISPEC ULTEM UT158 SERIES membawa keunggulan material berteknologi tinggi tersebut ke dalam desain kacamata modern, menghadirkan bingkai yang ringan, fleksibel, tahan lama, dan nyaman digunakan sepanjang hari.

  1. INFRA MERAH JAUH (FAR-INFRARED / FIR)

Infra merah Jauh (FIR) mempunyai rentang panjang gelombang yang aman yaitu 4–14 µm (micrometer).

Mikrometer merupakan satuan ukuran panjang yang sangat kecil.

  • 1 mikrometer (µm) = 0,001 milimeter (mm).
  • 4 µm = 4.000 nanometer (nm).
  • 14 µm = 14.000 nanometer (nm).

Jadi, 4–14 µm berarti panjang gelombang inframerah antara 4.000 hingga 14.000 nanometer.
